Leave a field out (or null) if you could not confirm it. Never guess fees. costs.* are per YEAR in PKR for the academicYear given. Run `npm run check` to test every link, and `npm run verify -- <slug>` after you re-check a university by hand.

medicalProcess.mdcat: MDCAT (Medical & Dental Colleges Admission Test) is the entry test you must pass to study MBBS or BDS in Pakistan. The Pakistan Medical & Dental Council (PM&DC) sets the rules, syllabus and pattern, and a university in each province runs the test. For MDCAT-2026: UHS Lahore (Punjab), Sukkur IBA University (Sindh), Khyber Medical University (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), Bolan University of Medical & Health Sciences (Balochistan), and Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University (Islamabad, AJK, Gilgit-Baltistan and Riyadh). You take the test in your own province/region of domicile. MDCAT-2026 had 180 multiple-choice questions (Biology 81 and the rest Chemistry, Physics, English and Logical Reasoning), on paper, in English, with no negative marking. Registration was on mdcat.pmdc.pk; the fee was PKR 9,000 for centres in Pakistan (PKR 13,000 late). The test was first set for 16 August 2026 and then moved to 20 September 2026. To pass you need at least 55% for MBBS and 50% for BDS (this pass mark is used in the 2026-27 admission rules of Punjab, Sindh, KP and Balochistan). In every province your final merit is: MDCAT 50% + FSc/HSSC (Pre-Medical) 40% + Matric/SSC 10%. Note: NUMS (the military medical university) runs its own 'NUMS MDCAT' for its colleges, such as Army Medical College.

provinces.explanation: UHS Lahore runs one central admission for all public (and private) medical and dental colleges in Punjab for session 2026-27. You need: an MDCAT pass (55% MBBS / 50% BDS, valid for 3 years; Punjab-domiciled students take the Punjab MDCAT), at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical or equivalent, and a Punjab domicile for open merit seats. You apply online (UHS fee Rs. 2,000) and, for public colleges, you must list ALL public colleges in your order of preference. The order cannot be changed after the last date. UHS makes college-wise merit lists by merit plus your preference; there are three or more lists, and higher students can be 'upgraded' to a better college. If selected, you must pay the college fee within 3 working days. Public-sector tuition for 2026-27 is Rs. 50,000 per year (open merit). No extra marks are given for Hafiz-e-Quran. Some seats are reserved (disabled students, under-developed districts, Cholistan, other regions, overseas Pakistanis). Note: Army Medical College is NOT in the UHS list; it admits through NUMS.

For Sindh public colleges, you need a permanent residence certificate (PRC)/domicile of Sindh (your father or mother must also hold a Sindh PRC), at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical (2026-27 prospectus; the 2025-26 advertisement said 65%, so check the current one), and an MDCAT pass (2024, 2025 or 2026 MDCAT by Sukkur IBA; 55% MBBS / 50% BDS). Seats are given by your 'tagged district': you apply to the processing university for your district (the 2026-27 prospectus lists jsmu.edu.pk, admissions.smbbmu.edu.pk and lumhs.edu.pk). You fill the online form, print it, and send it with documents through the named courier service (Rs. 3,500 per program in 2025-26). Merit is decided on merit-cum-choice. Each university also has a smaller number of 'self-finance' (UEDP/UDP) seats that cost much more (about PKR 650,000 per year) and are advertised after the merit lists. 2026-27 tentative dates: forms from 12 October 2026, last date 26 October 2026, MBBS final merit list 6 November 2026.

Khyber Medical University (KMU), Peshawar runs one central online admission for all public medical and dental colleges in KP (and reciprocal seats in AJK and other provinces) at cas.kmu.edu.pk. For 2026-27: forms opened 1 October 2026 and the last date is 21 October 2026, 5:00 PM. You need at least 65% in FSc Pre-Medical or equivalent, an MDCAT pass from 2024, 2025 or 2026 (55% MBBS / 50% BDS), and a KP or Newly Merged Districts domicile. Merit is SSC 10% + HSSC 40% + MDCAT 50%. Processing fee: Rs. 3,000 for MBBS and Rs. 3,000 for BDS. Seat types include Open Merit, Self Finance, Reciprocal, Disabled, Backward areas, Merged districts, Minorities and others. You choose colleges in order of preference and KMU places you by merit and choice.

For the government medical and dental colleges of Balochistan, the Government of Balochistan publishes one prospectus, and a Provincial Selection Committee selects students. You apply online on the Bolan Medical College website (bmc.edu.pk), print the final copy, pay the application fee at National Bank of Pakistan, and submit the print to the BMC Admission Branch. You need a Balochistan local/domicile certificate, at least 65% in FSc Pre-Medical, and an MDCAT pass (55% MBBS / 50% BDS; MDCAT in Balochistan is run by BUMHS). Merit is Matric 10% + FSc 40% + MDCAT 50%. Seats are split into provincial, divisional and district merit seats, plus disabled and minority seats. Your college preference order is final. Every admitted student signs a Rs. 3 million surety bond to serve the Balochistan Health Department for one year after house job.

provinces.province: Islamabad / AJK / Gilgit-Baltistan and NUMS (military) colleges
provinces.explanation: For MDCAT-2026, students of Islamabad, AJK and Gilgit-Baltistan took the test through Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University, Islamabad. Separately, the National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS) runs its own NUMS MDCAT and central admission for its constituent and military-run colleges. Army Medical College, Rawalpindi is listed by NUMS for 2026-27 as 'For Medical Cadets Only'.

universities.name: National University of Sciences and Technology
universities.about: NUST is a large public university in Islamabad. It is known for engineering, computing and business.
admissionSteps: Register on the NUST undergraduate admissions portal and fill the admission form.
Take the NUST Entry Test (NET).
If you need money help, say so on the portal. Then fill the Need Based Financial Aid form (NFAAF) before the NET deadline.

aid.name: NUST Need Based Financial Aid (NFAAF)
aid.amount: Partial or full study costs, for part or all of the degree (as stated by NUST). Exact amount depends on your family income.
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduate applicants who cannot pay the full fee.
howToApply: Register on the NUST undergraduate admissions portal.
Fill your admission form. Say that you want to apply for financial aid.
Open the 'Need Based Financial Aid Application' tab and fill the NFAAF form.
Upload papers like income proof of earning family members, CNICs and siblings' fee receipts. Each file must be under 250 KB.
Submit before the NET admission deadline. Applying for aid does not change your admission decision.

aid.name: Interest-free loans (Fee Deferment, Ihsan Trust)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students, as decided by NUST.
howToApply: Apply through the same NUST need based financial aid form (NFAAF).
Ask the NUST Financial Aid Office for current loan details.

aid.name: Outside need-based scholarships (PEEF, BEEF, CMEEF, SEEF and others)
aid.whoCanApply: Students from the province or group each fund supports.
howToApply: Submitting the NFAAF also makes you eligible for other need-based scholarships.
NUST says you must apply for outside scholarships (such as PEEF, BEEF, CMEEF, SEEF) to be considered for NUST's own scholarships.

universities.name: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology
universities.about: GIKI is a private engineering university in Topi, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Students live on campus in hostels.
admissionSteps: Apply online on the GIKI admissions portal (admissions.giki.edu.pk) and upload a photo.
If you need money help, apply online for PEEF, the Chief Minister KP scholarship or the GIKI interest-free loan at the same time.
Pay the processing fee: Rs. 3,500 for one test, Rs. 5,000 for both tests. Add Rs. 1,000 if you apply for financial assistance.
Take the online GIKI admission test (Physics, Maths and English for engineering).
Check your result online. If you get admission, send the listed documents.

hostel.notes: The yearly fee includes 'accommodation charges'. GIKI gives free electricity units to students in hostels. A Rs. 15,000 mess (food) security is also needed.

costs.otherNotes: GIKI gives ONE combined price for tuition and accommodation: Rs. 940,000 per year for Engineering and Computing (Rs. 470,000 per semester), and Rs. 825,000 per year for Management Sciences. Paying per semester adds 5% admin charges. One-time: Rs. 75,000 admission fee (non-refundable) and Rs. 40,000 refundable security. Rs. 15,000 mess security. Food (mess) is extra. Semester fee cannot be paid in instalments.

aid.name: GIK Financial Assistance (interest-free loan)
aid.amount: Full or partial tuition fee. About 40-50 students get it each year.
aid.whoCanApply: Needy and deserving students (need-cum-merit).
howToApply: Fill the financial assistance form with your online admission form.
Pay Rs. 1,000 extra processing fee with your admission fee.
GIKI tells you if you got the aid when it sends your admission offer.
You pay the loan back in easy 6-month instalments, starting one year after you graduate.

aid.name: GIK Merit Scholarship
aid.amount: Fully funded (20 seats)
aid.whoCanApply: Top 18 in the engineering admission test and top 2 in the management test.
howToApply: Given at the time of admission based on your test position.

aid.name: GIK Financial Assistance for Top Female students
aid.amount: Fully funded (10 seats)
aid.whoCanApply: Top 7 female students in engineering and top 3 in management.
howToApply: Apply at the time of admission.

aid.name: PEEF Scholarship (Punjab Educational Endowment Fund)
aid.amount: Fully funded (10 seats). GIKI's page also says Rs. 500,000.
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab domicile, at least 60% in Intermediate, family income not more than Rs. 720,000 a year, and you also meet GIKI's aid rules.
howToApply: Apply online with your GIKI admission form. You can apply only at admission time.

aid.name: Chief Minister KP scholarships (CMEEF and others)
aid.amount: Fully funded (CMEEF, 4 seats). GIKI's older section says the CM KP scholarship covers tuition only.
aid.whoCanApply: KP domicile with family income under the limit (CMEEF: under Rs. 1,200,000 a year).
howToApply: Apply online with your GIKI admission form, or after admission when the KP government announces it.

aid.name: Ihsan Trust Scholarship
aid.amount: Partial, tuition fee (40 seats)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students.
howToApply: Apply at admission, after results, or after one year at GIKI.

aid.name: Other donor and government scholarships (CM Honhaar Punjab, Sindh, KPEF, DWP+PSSF, GIK Alumni, Habbah Trust, Lucky Cement, Descon, ICI, PEL)
aid.amount: Mostly fully funded; seats are limited.
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on the scholarship (for example Punjab domicile with family income under Rs. 500,000 for CM Honhaar).
howToApply: Most of these are applied for after you join GIKI. Ask the Office of Student Affairs / Financial Aid.

universities.name: Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences
universities.about: PIEAS is a public engineering and science university in Islamabad. It offers BS degrees in engineering, computer science and physics.
admissionSteps: Go to admissions.pieas.edu.pk, make an account and fill the online form.
Upload your photo and academic documents.
Print the bank challan and pay the Rs. 3,500 application fee at Askari Bank (or online). Upload the paid slip.
Print your call letter and take the PIEAS written test (100 MCQs, 3 hours, no negative marking).
Merit = 60% test + 40% school marks. You need at least 60% in Matric and Intermediate.

hostel.notes: Rooms from a dormitory (Rs. 3,000 per month) up to a single room with attached bath (Rs. 13,500 per month). Hostel and transport are optional.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition is Rs. 4,000 per credit hour. PIEAS says an average BS semester is 18 credit hours = Rs. 72,000; we doubled this for 2 semesters. Each semester also has IT services Rs. 15,000 and university services Rs. 16,000, so a BS semester without hostel or transport is Rs. 103,000. One-time at joining: Rs. 60,000 (Rs. 35,000 admission + Rs. 25,000 refundable security). Hostel figure is PIEAS's own example: double room with shared bath, Rs. 6,750 x 6 months per semester (x 2 semesters). Cheaper rooms exist. Transport is Rs. 25,000 per semester if you use it. Food (mess) is extra. First semester fee must be paid in full.

aid.name: Qarz-e-Hasna for Tuition Fee (need-based tuition waiver)
aid.amount: 25% to 100% of tuition fee
aid.whoCanApply: BS students from poor families. You must keep a GPA of 2.67 or more to keep it.
howToApply: Pay the full fee for the first semester. No aid is given at admission time.
In the first semester, PIEAS emails you and posts on your student portal when applications open (first 3 weeks of Fall semester).
Get the form from the PIEAS Financial Aid Office and submit it with supporting documents.
Go for an interview with the Financial Aid Committee. The decision can take 8 to 10 weeks.
You are asked to pay the money back later when you are able, usually after you get a job.

aid.name: Qarz-e-Hasna for hostel, transport and other charges (Education Support Fund)
aid.amount: Hostel dues, transport and academic charges (not tuition). Limited number of students.
aid.whoCanApply: Needy BS students.
howToApply: Apply at the same time and on the same schedule as the tuition Qarz-e-Hasna. The committee decides if you get one or both.

aid.name: Living Expenses Support (mess bills)
aid.amount: Rs. 8,000 per month during Fall and Spring semesters
aid.whoCanApply: Highly deserving students who cannot pay their mess (food) bills.
howToApply: Apply through the PIEAS financial assistance process in the first semester.

aid.name: HEC scholarships (Ehsaas / Benazir Undergraduate, USAID need-based and others)
aid.amount: Ehsaas/Benazir: up to 100% of tuition plus Rs. 4,000 per month living stipend (as stated by PIEAS).
aid.whoCanApply: Students from low-income families. Rules are set by HEC.
howToApply: Watch for the advert on the HEC website and in newspapers.
Apply online on the HEC system.
Give hard copies with documents to the PIEAS Financial Aid Office by the deadline.
Go for an interview with the university scholarship committee.

aid.name: PEEF scholarships (Danish School students, Centre of Excellence, Special Quota, Merit)
aid.amount: For Danish School students: PEEF gives Rs. 136,500 a year and PIEAS waives 100% tuition, so tuition, academic and hostel/transport charges are covered.
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab-domiciled students who are not FSc repeaters. Special Quota is for orphans, children of BPS 1-4 government servants, disabled students, minorities, children of divorced mothers and others.
howToApply: The Financial Aid Office tells students when applications open (Special Quota usually in October). Apply online through the PEEF link.

aid.name: KPEF and BEEF scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: KPEF: students from KP/ex-FATA (4 per year). BEEF: students from Balochistan.
howToApply: Contact the PIEAS focal person / Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: Fellowships from public organizations
aid.amount: Full fee waiver, Rs. 10,000 per month stipend, and a job after the degree (on their terms).
aid.whoCanApply: BS students in their third semester who pass the organization's test and interview.
howToApply: Take the test and interview held at PIEAS in third semester.

universities.name: University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore
universities.about: UET Lahore is one of Pakistan's oldest and biggest public engineering universities. It has its main campus in Lahore and other campuses in Punjab.
admissionSteps: Register for and take the ECAT entry test (ECAT First or ECAT Second) at ecat.uet.edu.pk.
Fill the online admission form at admission.uet.edu.pk using your CNIC and challan number.
Merit = 33% ECAT + 50% first-year (FSc Part-I) marks + 17% Matric marks. You need at least 50% aggregate.
Check the merit lists and pay your dues by the deadline if selected.
If you live outside the city, apply for a hostel seat on the admission portal.

hostel.notes: Separate hostels for boys and girls; about 5,000 students live at the main campus. Seats are limited. Local (Lahore) students are NOT eligible for hostel. Cubicles and dormitories (2-10 students per room).

costs.otherNotes: For subsidized open-merit seats (category A1). Tuition fee is Rs. 56,290 per semester (x 2). One-time admission fee Rs. 54,050. UET's own schedule says year 1 total is Rs. 182,600 (54,050 + 56,290 + 72,260) and later years cost more. Partially subsidized seats (A2) cost much more: tuition Rs. 85,250 per semester. Hostel per semester (subsidized): dormitory Rs. 13,040 (used above, x 2), cubicle Rs. 17,750. One-time hostel admission fee Rs. 2,810. Food (mess) is extra. Facilities charges: Rs. 7,220 for day scholars and Rs. 3,610 for hostel students.

aid.name: Work and Study tuition waiver
aid.amount: Up to 50% of tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Students in categories A1, NM, N, L, Q, P, R, B, D, E, J1, J2 and O. A2, S and SI seats cannot get UET financial aid.
howToApply: Apply to the Office of Financial Aid & Career Services (FA&CS).
The Director FA&CS decides based on your papers.
If you get it, you must work 10 hours a week at a university office during that semester.

aid.name: Full tuition waiver for needy orphans, Balochistan and ex-FATA students, and disabled students
aid.amount: Full tuition waiver (Balochistan and disabled students: all university fees waived)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy orphan students on A1 seats; Balochistan-domiciled and disabled students (T or A1); needy FATA-domiciled students.
howToApply: Apply to the Director FA&CS (or In-charge Students' Section) with proof.

aid.name: Zakat Fund tuition fee waiver
aid.whoCanApply: Enrolled undergraduate students who need help.
howToApply: When FA&CS announces it, apply through the LMS scholarship portal before the deadline.

aid.name: UET Merit Scholarship
aid.amount: Full tuition waiver for one semester
aid.whoCanApply: Students who earn top positions in a semester.
howToApply: Given automatically by results, as per UET rules.

aid.name: Government and donor scholarships (HEC need-based, PEEF, CM Honhaar, CM KP, Lotte, Taleem Mumkin and others)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program. You can hold only one scholarship at a time.
howToApply: Watch the FA&CS website and notice boards. Most UET applications go through the LMS scholarship portal or the donor's online form.

universities.name: NED University of Engineering and Technology
universities.about: NED is a well-known public engineering university in Karachi. It is one of the oldest engineering schools in Pakistan.
admissionSteps: Fill the online application form on the NED admission portal (ugadmissions.neduet.edu.pk).
Print the transaction slip and pay the fee at a listed bank using the Transaction ID.
Download your admit card and take the computer-based Pre-Admission Entry Test. You need at least 50%. You may take it twice; the higher score counts.
Merit uses 60% test score. Check the call lists on the NED website.
Come on admission day with documents and pay the admission fee the same day.

hostel.notes: Karachi residents are NOT eligible for hostel. No food is provided by the university; canteens are available. Hostel charges are taken in advance each semester.

costs.otherNotes: Semester (tuition and exam) fee is Rs. 56,600 for most BE/BS programs (x 2 semesters). Plus Students Facilitation Charges Rs. 10,100 each semester. One-time admission fee Rs. 57,000 (includes Rs. 16,500 refundable security). Hostel (Muhammad Bin Qasim Hostels and Girls Hostel): room rent Rs. 1,035 per month (cubicle) or Rs. 805 per month (dormitory), plus service charges Rs. 1,035 per month. Refundable hostel security Rs. 5,000. Self-finance seats cost Rs. 890,000 or more extra.

aid.name: NED need-cum-merit scholarships (through Department of Students' Affairs)
aid.whoCanApply: Deserving and meritorious NED students. Funded by alumni, Government of Sindh, HEC, Sindh HEC, private donors and others (over 90 named scholarships).
howToApply: Watch department notice boards and official channels for scholarship announcements.
Fill the prescribed application form.
Get it recommended by your Class Advisor.
Submit it to the Department of Student Affairs.
Go to the interview if you are shortlisted.

aid.name: Assistance Scholarship
aid.amount: Rs. 5,000 per year
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students. The Vice-Chancellor selects based on money situation, grades and conduct.
howToApply: Ask the Department of Student Affairs.

aid.name: Hardship financial assistance
aid.whoCanApply: Students facing hardship, if donor funds are available.
howToApply: Contact the Department of Student Affairs.

aid.name: Ihsan Trust / Meezan Bank, Ehsaas (HEC), NBP Loan Scheme, Zakat & Ushr and other listed scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program.
howToApply: See the NED scholarship list and apply when Student Affairs announces each one.

universities.name: Mehran University of Engineering and Technology
universities.about: MUET is a public engineering university in Jamshoro, near Hyderabad, Sindh. Its Student Financial Aid Office says it helps more than 40% of students.
admissionSteps: Register on admissions.muet.edu.pk with a valid email and CNIC/B-Form number.
Pay the admission processing fee at any Habib Bank (HBL) branch and upload the paid challan and documents.
Download your admit slip and take the MUET Pre-Admission Test. You need at least 40%.
Merit = 60% test + 30% HSC-I + 10% Matric. Tests and merit lists are district-wise, with interviews the next day.
If selected, pay the admission fee on interview day.

hostel.notes: Separate hostels for male and female students (three female hostels). Seats are limited and given by district quota, first come first served. Students from districts with a university bus (Jamshoro, Hyderabad, Matiari, Tando Allahyar, Tando Muhammad Khan, Mirpurkhas) are considered only if seats are left. Apply online on form MUH-I & II.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition is Rs. 25,000 per semester (x 2). Each semester total for all BE students is Rs. 48,800 (includes Rs. 18,000 transport). Yearly at admission: Rs. 42,450 (admission fee Rs. 27,800 + other charges; includes Rs. 6,600 refundable caution money). Hostel: Rs. 8,700 at allotment, then Rs. 35,800 per semester for boarders (room Rs. 12,000, utility Rs. 6,000, admission Rs. 3,100, medical Rs. 700, transport Rs. 14,000) - we doubled this for the year. Food is extra (paid at hostel messes).

aid.name: MUET Financial Assistance on Poverty Basis, SAEF Scholarship and Internal Merit Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Needy and deserving MUET students.
howToApply: Contact the Student Financial Aid Office (SFAO): sfao@admin.muet.edu.pk, phone +92 22 2771274.
Apply when SFAO announces scholarships.
Go for an interview with the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee (ISAC) if shortlisted.

aid.name: Interest-free educational loans
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students.
howToApply: Ask the Student Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: Outside scholarships listed by MUET (HEC Ehsaas, USAID need-based, Sindh Educational Endowment Fund, Zakat & Ushr Sindh, PEF, PEEF, BEEF, Thar Foundation, HBL, and others)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program (more than 40 programs listed).
howToApply: Follow SFAO announcements and apply as told. Interviews are held by the ISAC.

universities.name: University of Engineering and Technology, Peshawar
universities.about: UET Peshawar is the main public engineering university of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It has campuses in Peshawar, Bannu, Nowshera and Abbottabad.
admissionSteps: Take the entrance test by ETEA (KP's testing agency). Students from other provinces may use their own province's public engineering university test.
Apply online to UET Peshawar before the last date.
Merit = 50% entrance test + 40% Intermediate Part-I + 10% Matric.
If selected, pay the first fee instalment on the day of admission.

hostel.notes: Separate hostels for boys and girls on several campuses. Seats are limited and given by merit and need. No hostel for boys in 1st semester at Abbottabad campus. Food: each resident joins the hostel mess (no-profit no-loss) and pays separately.

costs.otherNotes: Open merit engineering, Peshawar main campus. This is the 'university fee' for year 1: 1st semester Rs. 93,500 (2 x 46,750) + 2nd semester Rs. 85,000 (2 x 42,500). Later years differ (whole degree Rs. 773,934). Some campus programs (Bannu EE, Nowshera, Abbottabad Electronics) are cheaper: Rs. 546,306 for 4 years. Fee rises 10% each year. Hostel per academic year: seat Rs. 34,000 + hostel fund Rs. 16,000 = Rs. 50,000 (cubicle Rs. 36,000 + 16,000 = Rs. 52,000). Mess (food) is extra.

aid.name: In-affordability (poverty-cum-merit) Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: A limited number of poor students with good grades.
howToApply: Watch the UET website, department notice boards and social media for scholarship announcements.
Apply for the scholarship.
Your department sends shortlisted forms to the Director of Undergraduate Studies (DUGS).
Go for an interview with the Central Scholarship Management Committee.
If selected, the money is paid by cheque or adjusted in your fee.

aid.name: Tuition freeship and sibling concession
aid.amount: Free tuition for deserving students (UET site says up to 15 students). If two or more brothers/sisters study at UET, the younger ones pay half tuition.
aid.whoCanApply: Deserving students recommended by the Scholarship Award Committee. Not for students who already get other aid, and not for self-finance seats.
howToApply: Apply through the Scholarships Office / Scholarship Award Committee.

aid.name: University Merit Scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Students in 3rd, 5th and 7th semesters based on last results (CGPA 2.00 or more), who get no other scholarship.
howToApply: Awarded on results.

aid.name: Outside scholarships listed by UET (KP Education Foundation, Chief Minister's Education Endowment Fund, HEC need-based, PEF, MORA Zakat, Karwan-e-Ilm, NBP loan scheme, Lucky Cement and others)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program. Only one scholarship at a time.
howToApply: Apply when UET announces it, following the same UET selection steps above.

universities.name: University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila
universities.about: UET Taxila is a public engineering university near Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
admissionSteps: Take the TCAT/ECAT or an equivalent test (UET Lahore's ECAT registration usually starts in February/March).
Go to admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk, click 'MY UET' and register with your CNIC/B-Form number.
Fill the online form and pay the Rs. 4,000 processing fee (HBL app or Bank of Punjab).
Merit = 50% HSSC-I + 33% entry test + 17% Matric. You need 60% marks for engineering.
If selected, pay the semester fee, upload the paid challan and submit original documents.

hostel.notes: Limited hostel seats, mainly for male students, given on merit. Girls have very limited places. Students living in Taxila, Wah Cantt, Rawalpindi and Islamabad get hostel only if seats are left.

costs.otherNotes: Subsidized seats: tuition Rs. 38,000 per semester (x 2). Total first semester for subsidized students is Rs. 101,800 (2025 prospectus); the current admissions FAQ says about Rs. 104,800 without hostel. Partial-subsidized (S and X) seats cost much more (tuition Rs. 130,000 per semester). Bus fare Rs. 22,000 per semester for day scholars, Rs. 10,000 for hostel students. Hostel first semester: the FAQ says about Rs. 36,000-40,000.

aid.name: University Welfare Scholarship and fee concession on need basis
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students. Department chairman can also give up to 30 extra days or 2 instalments to pay dues.
howToApply: Contact the Dues & Financial Aid Services section (under the Treasurer).

aid.name: University Merit Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Students with top results.
howToApply: Watch the Scholarships Notices page for award notices.

aid.name: Outside scholarships listed by UET Taxila (HEC Benazir Undergraduate, OGDCL need-based via HEC, PEEF, Punjab Honhaar, Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal, PEF, Alumni Association need-cum-merit, NBP loan scheme and others)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program. Only one scholarship at a time.
howToApply: Check the UET Taxila Scholarships Notices page and apply as each notice says.

universities.name: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences
universities.about: A private, not-for-profit university known for computer science, engineering and business. It has campuses in Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Chiniot-Faisalabad and Multan.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Check the admission dates on the FAST admissions schedule page.
Step 2: Apply online only, through the official FAST admission portal. You will get your own ARN (Application Reference Number).
Step 3: Check all your details carefully before you pay the application fee.
Step 4: For a bachelor's degree, choose your test: the NU Admission Test, or SAT/NTS.
Step 5: If you are selected, pay the admission charges (admission fee, security deposit, first semester tuition and student activities fund) before the deadline.

hostel.notes: The official FAQ says hostels are available at the Chiniot-Faisalabad, Multan and Peshawar campuses. It does not list hostels for Islamabad, Lahore or Karachi. No hostel fees are published on the official pages we checked.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition is Rs 12,000 per credit hour for BS/BBA (from Fall 2026, for all batches). FAST says it has no fixed semester fee. Example from the official FAQ: 15 credit hours = about Rs 180,000 tuition for one semester. One-time charges: admission fee Rs 30,000 and refundable security deposit Rs 20,000. Student Activities Fund Rs 2,500 per semester. Fees may be paid in installments if the campus administration approves. Living at home saves the hostel cost; hostel fees are not published.

aid.name: FAST Study Loan (Qarz-e-Hasna)
aid.whoCanApply: Bright students who cannot afford the fees and can show financial need. The form is for new students. Internal sponsorships cover tuition fee only, for up to 8 semesters for a bachelor's degree.
howToApply: Step 1: Download the Study Loan Application Form from the FAST scholarship page (fa-form-2026.pdf).
Step 2: Fill in and sign the form. Give full details of family income and all family property.
Step 3: Attach documents: salary or pension certificates and income tax returns of father/guardian, mother, brothers and sisters, plus recent telephone, gas and electricity bills of your home.
Step 4: Submit it to your FAST campus before the deadline that your campus announces.
Step 5: Repayment starts 3 months after graduation or after you get a job (whichever is earlier). You must pay it all back within 4 years of graduating. It is interest-free.

aid.name: FAST Merit Scholarship
aid.amount: Full tuition fee for four years
aid.whoCanApply: Top three position holders of each examination board in the year of admission, and the top three on the NU admission merit list at each campus. You must keep a semester GPA of 3.0 or higher.
howToApply: Step 1: There is no separate form listed. Students are chosen by their ranking.
Step 2: Keep a semester GPA of 3.0 or more, take the normal credit load and do not fail, repeat or withdraw from courses, to keep the scholarship.

aid.name: Sindh Government Endowment Board Scholarship
aid.amount: Full tuition fee for the whole program, renewed every year
aid.whoCanApply: Need-cum-merit for rural and urban students (60% rural quota, 40% urban quota).
howToApply: Step 1: Ask the financial aid office at your FAST campus when applications open. The FAST page does not give the steps.

aid.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
aid.whoCanApply: Talented and needy students from Punjab and other areas listed by FAST (AJK, FATA, Gilgit-Baltistan, Islamabad).
howToApply: Step 1: Read the rules on the PEEF website (www.peef.org.pk), which FAST links to.
Step 2: Ask your FAST campus financial aid office how to submit.

aid.name: Ihsan Trust financial assistance
aid.whoCanApply: Students who cannot pay their full fee.
howToApply: Step 1: Ask your FAST campus financial aid office. FAST lists this program but does not give steps.

aid.name: OSAF and FANA alumni scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Students who cannot pay their full fee. Funded by FAST alumni (Old Students Association of FAST, and FAST Alumni of North America).
howToApply: Step 1: Ask your FAST campus financial aid office. OSAF's website is www.osaf.org.pk.

universities.name: COMSATS University Islamabad
universities.about: A large public university with strong computer science and engineering programs. Besides Islamabad, it has campuses in Lahore, Abbottabad, Wah, Attock, Sahiwal and Vehari, plus a virtual campus.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Go to the COMSATS admissions portal and choose the campus you want to apply to.
Step 2: Sign up with your name, email and a password, then fill in the online application.
Step 3: Pay the application fee and wait for 'Fee Verified' to show on your portal.
Step 4: Take the required admission test (the portal shows when the NTS test is available).
Step 5: Check the merit list on the portal. If you are on merit, pay your fees to confirm your seat.

hostel.notes: We could not find official hostel information or fees for the Islamabad campus. Other COMSATS campuses (for example Lahore and Attock) publish their own hostel pages. Ask your campus before you plan to live in a hostel.

costs.otherNotes: Per semester for new students (Fall 2026 batch), from the official fee notification dated May 18, 2026: Computer Science programs Rs 153,500 tuition + Rs 7,000 registration = Rs 160,500; Engineering programs Rs 159,500 + Rs 7,000 = Rs 166,500; Other programs Rs 141,500 + Rs 7,000 = Rs 148,500. One-time admission fee Rs 27,000. Degree fee Rs 10,000 at the end. Fees may change in later semesters. The notice does not say how many semesters are in a year, so we did not calculate a yearly amount. Hostel fee for Islamabad not found.

aid.name: HEC-Ehsaas / BISP Need Based Scholarship
aid.amount: Listed as 'fully funded' by CUI Lahore. HEC says grantees get university fee plus Rs 6,000 per month stipend.
aid.whoCanApply: Newly enrolled BS students admitted on open merit, based on need assessment. Students admitted on self-finance cannot apply (HEC rule).
howToApply: Step 1: Watch for the HEC need-based scholarship notice from the Student Financial Aid Office of your campus (usually early in the Fall semester).
Step 2: Get the form (CUI Lahore says forms are at the campus shop and on its website).
Step 3: Fill it in with your family income details and attach the documents asked for.
Step 4: Submit it to your campus Student Financial Aid Office before the deadline. The university committee will check your need.

aid.name: Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna (interest-free loan)
aid.amount: Partially funded (amount based on need)
aid.whoCanApply: All open merit BS/MS students, based on need assessment.
howToApply: Step 1: Download the Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna application form from the COMSATS internal scholarships page.
Step 2: Fill it in and submit it to the Student Financial Aid Office of your campus.

aid.name: CUI Endowment Fund scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students (details not published).
howToApply: Step 1: Download the Endowment Fund Application Form from the COMSATS internal scholarships page.
Step 2: Submit it to your campus Student Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: Kinship / Siblings concession
aid.amount: Partial (amount not published)
aid.whoCanApply: Open merit BS students when two or more siblings study at CUI at the same time.
howToApply: Step 1: Contact the financial aid office at your campus for the form and details.

aid.name: Merit scholarships (High Achievers / Admission Toppers)
aid.amount: High Achievers: 100% tuition. Admission Toppers: fully funded.
aid.whoCanApply: CUI Lahore list: top 10 board position holders (keep CGPA 3.50) and admission merit toppers of each BS program (keep CGPA 2.50).
howToApply: Step 1: Ask your campus Student Financial Aid Office. Lists can differ by campus.

aid.name: Other donor and government schemes (PEEF, KPK-FEF, BEEF, Abdullah Foundation, Alpha Foundation, Diya Pakistan, NBP interest-free loan, EDUFI study loan)
aid.amount: Most are partially funded; Abdullah and Alpha Foundation listed as fully funded
aid.whoCanApply: Mostly open merit students based on need. PEEF needs Punjab domicile and 60% marks; KPK-FEF needs KPK domicile.
howToApply: Step 1: Get the form from your campus Student Financial Aid Office or the CUI scholarships portal.
Step 2: Submit with income documents before the deadline.

universities.name: Air University
universities.about: A public university set up by the Pakistan Air Force, with programs in engineering, computing, AI and business. Its main campus is in Islamabad, with other campuses including Multan, Kamra and Karachi.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Register on the AU online admission portal with a valid email (Google sign-up is recommended).
Step 2: Fill in the online form and attach your HSSC marksheet, CNIC/B-Form and a photo.
Step 3: Pay the Rs 2,500 non-refundable processing fee.
Step 4: If you need financial help, select the need-based grant form inside the online admission form.
Step 5: Take the AU computer-based test (100 MCQs, no negative marking).
Step 6: Check the merit list and pay your fees to confirm admission.

hostel.notes: We did not find an official hostel page or fee for local students at the Islamabad main campus. AU's international admissions page mentions 'local hostels' 8 to 40 minutes from the Islamabad campus with no mess. The Kamra campus has its own hostel block.

costs.otherNotes: Islamabad, first semester tuition: BS Computer Science Rs 9,150 per credit hour x 15 = Rs 137,250; BE Electrical / Mechanical Rs 8,050 x 17 = Rs 136,850; BS Cyber Security Rs 9,150 x 18 = Rs 164,700. One-time: admission fee Rs 20,000, endowment fund Rs 5,000, refundable security deposit Rs 10,000, application processing Rs 2,500. Miscellaneous charges Rs 6,000 in the first semester, then Rs 5,500 per semester. Credit hours change each semester, so no yearly total is given. Hostel fee not published.

aid.name: Air University Need Based Financial Grant (AUNBFG)
aid.amount: Depends on available funds
aid.whoCanApply: Students admitted on open merit only. You must keep good conduct and a CGPA of at least 2.0. Only one need-based grant per student.
howToApply: Step 1: In the online admission form, select the grant form.
Step 2: After your admission is confirmed, submit your documents to the Financial Aid Office (FAO) within 15 days of the semester start.
Step 3: If you forgot to apply online, apply to the Registrar on the prescribed form within 15 days of the semester start.
Step 4: If you join in Spring, apply in the following Fall on the prescribed form.

aid.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship
aid.amount: HEC says: university fee plus Rs 6,000 per month stipend (subject to funding)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy undergraduate students admitted on open merit (not self-finance).
howToApply: Step 1: Apply through the AU Financial Aid Office when the scholarship is announced (same process as the AU need-based grant).
Step 2: Submit your income documents to the FAO within the deadline.

aid.name: Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship and PEEF
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students, when the government/HEC or PEEF offers it.
howToApply: Step 1: Contact the AU Financial Aid Office (Ext. 214, 051-9153214) when the program is announced.

aid.name: Merit scholarships based on semester results
aid.amount: Rs 25,000 (1st), Rs 20,000 (2nd), Rs 15,000 (3rd) tuition waiver per batch, plus Rs 5,000 extra for SGPA 4.0
aid.whoCanApply: Top three undergraduates in each program batch with SGPA 3.5 or more and full course load.
howToApply: Step 1: No form needed. The Financial Aid Office gives it automatically after results.

aid.name: PAF ward rebate
aid.amount: 25% tuition rebate for the normal degree length
aid.whoCanApply: Children of serving or retired PAF personnel (with service or retirement documents).
howToApply: Step 1: Submit proof of PAF service or retirement to the Financial Aid Office.

universities.name: Institute of Space Technology
universities.about: A public university in Islamabad focused on aerospace, space science, engineering and computing. It has hostels on campus for boys and girls.
admissionSteps: Step 1: BS admissions open once a year (around March/April). Watch the IST admissions page.
Step 2: Take an accepted entry test. IST does not hold its own test; check the entry test page.
Step 3: Fill in the online application form and upload your documents (including your test result).
Step 4: Pay the Rs 3,000 non-refundable application processing fee.
Step 5: Check the merit list. If selected, pay your fees, then register; hostel and transport places are given after registration.

hostel.notes: IST has furnished hostels for boys and girls inside the campus. Dormitory charges are Rs 60,500 per semester (plus Rs 1,000 locker rent). Hostel is optional and given only after registration. Mess (food) cost is not listed.

costs.otherNotes: Numbers are for BS Computer Science / AI / Data Science / Software / Computer Engineering: tuition Rs 127,962 per semester, x2 semesters a year (IST FAQ says there are two semesters each year) = Rs 255,924. With service and campus charges the total is Rs 138,852 per semester. Aerospace/Electrical/Avionics/Mechanical Engineering: tuition Rs 151,534 per semester (total Rs 162,424). One-time charges: Rs 49,000 (admission, endowment, library). Dormitory Rs 60,500 per semester x2 = Rs 121,000 a year, without food. Living at home saves this hostel cost; IST transport is only for Islamabad/Rawalpindi students at contract rates.

aid.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship
aid.amount: HEC says: university fee plus Rs 6,000 per month stipend
aid.whoCanApply: Needy BS students admitted to IST, subject to available funds and seats.
howToApply: Step 1: Finish your IST admission first.
Step 2: Watch for the HEC need-based scholarship notice at IST.
Step 3: Send the complete application to the IST financial aid office before the deadline.

aid.name: Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Students from low-income families studying in a 4-5 year bachelor's program at a public university.
howToApply: Step 1: Apply when HEC announces the Ehsaas scholarship (IST tells needy students to apply then).

aid.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
aid.whoCanApply: Talented but needy students admitted to IST.
howToApply: Step 1: Read the details at https://www.peef.org.pk/Scholarships_Main.html and apply as PEEF explains.

aid.name: NBP interest-free student loan
aid.whoCanApply: IST students (rules set by National Bank of Pakistan).
howToApply: Step 1: Follow the process on https://www.nbp.com.pk/studentloan/ (linked by IST).

aid.name: IST Merit Scholarship (BS)
aid.amount: 100% (1st), 50% (2nd), 25% (3rd) tuition fee waiver
aid.whoCanApply: Top three students in each BS program. First semester: by admission merit with more than 80% in HSSC. Later semesters: SGPA above 3.50 with full course load.
howToApply: Step 1: No form needed. It is given on admission merit and semester results.

aid.name: Sponsorship by national R&D organizations
aid.amount: Tuition fee, plus a guaranteed job after graduation if you meet the sponsor's conditions
aid.whoCanApply: Deserving BS students of selected programs, after a test and interview.
howToApply: Step 1: Ask the IST admissions office which programs have sponsorships and when the test/interview is held.

universities.name: Habib University
universities.about: A private liberal arts university in Karachi with science and engineering (DSSE) and arts, humanities and social sciences (AHSS) schools. Fees are high, but the university says about 85% of students get some financial help.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Register online, fill the e-application, upload documents and pay the PKR 2,500 application fee.
Step 2: Submit your scholarship and financial aid application with supporting documents (inside your e-application).
Step 3: (Optional) Join the free HU TOPS / HU EOP prep program.
Step 4: Take the Habib University Entrance Examination.
Step 5: Top candidates who meet the merit score get an admission offer with their scholarship/aid package.

hostel.notes: Habib says it is a non-residential campus. Students from outside Karachi stay with relatives, in private hostels in Karachi, or share rented flats. HU TOPS and HU EOP do not cover accommodation or living costs.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition Rs 780,000 per semester x 2 regular semesters (Fall and Spring) = Rs 1,560,000 a year, before any scholarship. DSSE (science and engineering) also pays a laboratory fee of Rs 215,000 per semester; AHSS pays a studio/lab fee of Rs 160,000 per semester. Semester registration fee Rs 32,000 from the 2nd semester (not covered by scholarship or aid). Tax may apply and fees may rise each year. There is no university hostel, so students from outside Karachi must pay for private housing themselves.

aid.name: HU TOPS Scholarship
aid.amount: 100% of tuition, lab fee and semester registration fee for four years
aid.whoCanApply: Students from a Board of Intermediate Education, Federal Board or AKU-EB finishing HSSC II by September 2027. Science group: 85% in SSC and 80% in HSSC. Other groups: 80% SSC and 75% HSSC. Keep CGPA 3.00.
howToApply: Step 1: Register on the HU TOPS portal, fill the e-application, upload documents, pay PKR 2,500.
Step 2: Submit the scholarship and financial aid application with documents.
Step 3: (Optional) Attend the free HU TOPS Prep Program.
Step 4: Take the Habib entrance test (Karachi deadlines run 21 Oct 2026 to 16 Feb 2027 depending on the test series; Islamabad January series closes 4 Jan 2027).
Step 5: Top candidates get the offer.

aid.name: HU EOP (Equal Opportunity Program) Scholarship
aid.amount: Up to 80% of tuition, lab and semester registration fees
aid.whoCanApply: Board students (BIE, Federal Board, AKU-EB) finishing HSSC II by September 2027 with 70% or more in SSC and HSSC (75% in SSC for science group from BIE/Federal Board). Keep CGPA 3.00.
howToApply: Step 1: Register on the HU EOP portal, fill the e-application, upload documents, pay PKR 2,500.
Step 2: Submit the scholarship and financial aid application.
Step 3: (Optional) Attend the free HU EOP Prep Program.
Step 4: Take the entrance test.
Step 5: Top candidates who meet the merit score are offered reserved seats.

aid.name: Habib Financial Aid Grants
aid.amount: Based on need (personal plan for each student)
aid.whoCanApply: Any admitted student who shows financial need. Grants do not need to be paid back. Keep CGPA 2.33 and full-time status; reviewed every year.
howToApply: Step 1: Log in to your e-application (eapplication.habib.edu.pk) and open the scholarship/financial aid application.
Step 2: Fill it in with your family's financial details and upload documents. You can apply for aid and scholarships at the same time.
Step 3: Habib gives you a personal aid package with your admission offer.
Step 4: Each year, submit an updated financial aid form with new documents to keep your aid.

aid.name: Ihsan Trust Loan (through Habib)
aid.amount: Depends on need (decided by HU committee and Ihsan Trust interview)
aid.whoCanApply: Students with demonstrated financial need, as part of their Habib financial aid package.
howToApply: Step 1: Apply for financial aid at Habib (see above).
Step 2: If you are offered an Ihsan Trust loan, Habib staff give you the forms (new students fill them on bond paper).
Step 3: Attend the Ihsan Trust interview (you are told 3 days before).
Step 4: Pay a small token amount while studying, then repay monthly after graduation based on your income.

aid.name: Merit scholarships (Habib YOHSIN, Excellence, Merit)
aid.amount: YOHSIN 100%; Excellence 60-80%; Merit up to 50%
aid.whoCanApply: Based on your admission score. Must keep CGPA 3.50 (YOHSIN), 3.00 (Excellence) or 2.75 (Merit).
howToApply: Step 1: Apply for admission and the scholarship application in the e-application. Awards are based on your admission score.

universities.name: Sir Syed University of Engineering and Technology
universities.about: A private engineering and computing university in Karachi. It offers many BE, BS and BE Tech programs.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Click 'Apply Online' on the SSUET admissions page and register your email.
Step 2: Fill in the form and upload your documents and photo.
Step 3: Pay the Rs 3,900 test fee (challan at MCB, or online via PayPro).
Step 4: Take the computer-based aptitude test (and interview if needed).
Step 5: Check results and the merit list. If you get an offer on your portal, pay the fee on the challan to reserve your seat.

hostel.notes: An SSUET program page says the university provides a hostel for students from outside Karachi, but we found no official hostel details or fees.

costs.otherNotes: From the official Undergraduate Fee Structure 2026-27 (first semester): Computer Science Rs 7,700 per credit hour x 18 = Rs 138,600 tuition, total first semester fee Rs 196,400. Electrical Engineering Rs 6,600 x 18 = Rs 118,800, total Rs 176,600. One-time admission fee Rs 35,000 (Rs 15,000 for some programs) and security deposit Rs 5,000. Each semester also has semester registration, exam and student activity charges. Credit hours change each semester, so no yearly total is given. Self-finance seats pay an extra one-time Rs 250,000. AIT graduates and children of industrial employees get discounts on some BE Tech programs.

aid.name: SSUET Financial Assistance
aid.amount: 30% of tuition fee (100 seats)
aid.whoCanApply: Regular SSUET students with GPA 2.75 or more, 85% attendance, and parents' income up to Rs 600,000 per year (with proof). Not for students already getting another scholarship, or children of SSUET staff.
howToApply: Step 1: Get the scholarship/financial assistance application form from the SSUET scholarship notice.
Step 2: Print it on both sides of one sheet and fill it in by hand.

Step 3: Attach: latest transcript, university ID card, parents' CNIC, parent income certificate or pay slip (or tax return, or Rs 100 stamp paper affidavit if self-employed), pension book if any, latest electricity bill (must), FRC.
Step 4: Submit it yourself to the Scholarship Department, Room AB-03, Basement, Block-A, before the deadline (current round: 12 to 27 October 2026).
Step 5: The Scholarship Committee checks your papers and decides.

aid.name: Two Brother/Sister (siblings) scholarship
aid.amount: 30% of tuition fee
aid.whoCanApply: Two siblings studying at SSUET, GPA 3.00 or more and 85% attendance.
howToApply: Step 1: Use the same scholarship application form and attach the FRC/B-Form.
Step 2: Submit to the Scholarship Department before the deadline.

aid.name: Merit Scholarship and Top Performer free-ship
aid.amount: Top performer of the batch: 100% tuition (free-ship). Merit: 35% of tuition (500 seats).
aid.whoCanApply: Top performer: GPA 3.75+ and 90% attendance. Merit: GPA 3.65+ and 90% attendance.
howToApply: Step 1: No application needed. It is given automatically.

universities.name: Dawood University of Engineering and Technology
universities.about: A public engineering university in Karachi (since 1962) offering PEC-accredited engineering, architecture and computing degrees.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Choose your program and read the current admission advertisement.
Step 2: Register on the online admission portal and fill in the form.
Step 3: Upload your marksheets, certificates, CNIC/B-Form, domicile and photo.
Step 4: Pay the processing fee and keep the deposit slip.
Step 5: Take the admission test if required.
Step 6: Check the merit list, pay the semester fee and complete enrolment by the deadline.

hostel.notes: The Directorate of Students Affairs handles hostel allocation and residence rules. No hostel fees are published.

aid.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship
aid.amount: Full tuition and stipend (HEC says Rs 6,000 per month)
aid.whoCanApply: Students from low-income households, on verified need. HEC rule: not for self-finance students.
howToApply: Step 1: Watch for the scholarship notice from the DUET Financial Assistance Department each semester.
Step 2: Submit the application with income certificate, utility bills and academic record.
Step 3: Attend the verification interview with the scholarship committee.
Step 4: If selected, the award is shown on your student portal and taken off your semester fee challan.

aid.name: Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Eligible undergraduates (federal program covering tuition and living stipend).
howToApply: Step 1: Apply through the DUET Financial Assistance Department when announced (same steps as above).

aid.name: Government of Sindh Endowment Fund
aid.whoCanApply: Students with Sindh domicile studying professional degrees.
howToApply: Step 1: Apply through the DUET Financial Assistance Department when the notice comes out.

aid.name: Merit scholarships
aid.amount: Semester tuition waivers (amount not published)
aid.whoCanApply: Top performing students in each department.
howToApply: Step 1: Based on results; ask your department or the Financial Assistance Department.

aid.name: Industry and alumni donor awards; fee concessions and installment plans
aid.whoCanApply: Deserving engineering and computing students.
howToApply: Step 1: Contact the Financial Assistance Department, which manages donor funds, fee concessions and installment plans.

universities.name: Information Technology University of the Punjab
universities.about: A public university in Lahore, set up by the Government of Punjab, focused on computer science, engineering and technology. It has a city campus at Arfa Software Technology Park and a campus on Barki Road.
admissionSteps: Step 1: Create a new account on the ITU online admission portal (you need a Gmail or Yahoo email). ITU only takes online applications.
Step 2: Fill in the application and upload your documents.
Step 3: Take the ITU Admission Test (held around July; admissions are for the Fall semester only).
Step 4: If you are on the merit list, bring your original documents and CNIC/B-Form for verification and pay your fee.

hostel.notes: ITU offers hostel accommodation for male students only (FAQ says at the Barki campus). No hostel for female students mentioned. Fees not published. In Fall 2026, 60% of seats went to the new batch. Apply through the Academics Office (hostel@itu.edu.pk).

costs.otherNotes: BS Computer Science: tuition Rs 164,000 in Fall 2026 + Rs 164,000 in Spring 2027 = Rs 328,000. University dues are extra: Rs 47,300 (Fall 2026) + Rs 40,000 (Spring 2027), so the total for the first year is Rs 415,300. Tuition rises in later years (5% yearly increase); the whole 4-year degree is listed as Rs 1,767,300. Rate is Rs 9,600 per credit hour. Hostel fee not published.

aid.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
aid.amount: HEC says: university fee plus Rs 6,000 per month stipend (subject to HEC funds)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students under HEC rules (open merit, not self-finance).
howToApply: Step 1: Watch for ITU's announcement of the HEC need-based scholarship.
Step 2: Send the complete application to ITU's financial aid office before the deadline.

aid.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
aid.amount: Up to 100 awards at ITU (76 for BS, 24 for MS)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy and talented students, under PEEF rules.
howToApply: Step 1: Follow PEEF's rules and ask ITU (admission@itu.edu.pk, 042-99046061) when the call opens.

aid.name: Honhaar Undergraduate Scholarship Program
aid.whoCanApply: As set by the Government of Punjab.
howToApply: Step 1: Follow the Government of Punjab Honhaar instructions; ask ITU for guidance.

aid.name: Top 3 Merit Scholarship (new intake)
aid.amount: Tuition waiver for the first semester
aid.whoCanApply: Top 3 admitted students in each discipline.
howToApply: Step 1: No form needed. Winners are announced two weeks after classes start.

aid.name: CGPA Merit Scholarship (BS)
aid.amount: Next semester tuition waiver: 100% (CGPA 3.8-4.0), 75% (3.65-3.79), 50% (3.5-3.64)
aid.whoCanApply: Current BS students with full workload, no repeats, no W/F grades and no disciplinary case.
howToApply: Step 1: Based on your CGPA; no separate steps are listed.

universities.name: Institute of Business Administration, Karachi
universities.about: IBA Karachi is one of Pakistan's oldest and best-known business schools. It offers BBA and many BS degrees, such as Computer Science, Economics and Accounting & Finance.
admissionSteps: Read the test dates, past papers and course outline on admissions.iba.edu.pk.
Make an account and apply online at onlineadmission.iba.edu.pk.
Take the IBA Aptitude Test (English and Maths).
If you get an admission offer and need money help, apply for financial assistance at the time of admission. New students can only apply then.

hostel.notes: IBA lists hostel fees for single, double and shared rooms, with or without AC. AC electricity is charged extra.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition is PKR 31,500 per credit hour for all undergraduate programs (Fall 2026 admission). The page does not say how many credit hours you take per year, so we did not calculate a yearly total. One-time admission charge: PKR 125,000. Student activity charge: PKR 7,000 (shown next to BBA). Hostel is charged per semester: PKR 126,400 (3+ sharing, no AC) up to PKR 147,000 (single AC room). The yearly hostel number here is the cheapest room x 2 semesters (Fall + Spring) = PKR 252,800. A 3% Sindh sales tax may apply. If you live at home in Karachi, you do not pay hostel fees.

aid.name: IBA Need-Based Scholarship (bridge financing)
aid.amount: 25% to 90% of tuition, decided by the Financial Assistance Committee
aid.whoCanApply: Full-time morning-program students who cannot pay fees even with installments or Qarz-e-Hasna. You must keep a CGPA of at least 2.5. It covers up to 8 semesters. Repeated or withdrawn courses are not covered.
howToApply: Get admission to IBA first. New students apply only at the time of admission.
Fill the online form at ibaapps.iba.edu.pk/financialassistance during the dates given on the Important Dates page.

Scan and attach all documents from the Document Checklist, including CNICs of all family members over 18 and income tax returns of earning family members (Gilgit-Baltistan residents are exempt from tax returns).
The committee reviews your case. You may get an interview, a phone call or a home visit.
If approved, you must also apply for outside donor scholarships that IBA tells you about, or the aid stops.
Apply again at the start of every academic year.

aid.name: Qarz-e-Hasna (interest-free loan)
aid.whoCanApply: IBA students who need help paying fees. IBA says it is arranged through outside donors.
howToApply: Read the Qarz-e-Hasna page on the IBA Financial Aid website.
Contact the Financial Assistance Department: financial-aid@iba.edu.pk.

aid.name: Fee Installment Plan
aid.whoCanApply: IBA students who can pay the fee, but not all at once.
howToApply: Read the Fee Installment Plan page on the IBA Financial Aid website.
Contact financial-aid@iba.edu.pk.

aid.name: National Talent Hunt Program (NTHP)
aid.amount: The orientation is free. Selected students also get a free IBA aptitude test (one eligible round). A limited number of NTHP scholarships are given to students who pass the test; IBA does not say on the NTHP pages exactly what they cover.
aid.whoCanApply: Financially deserving students from all over Pakistan who are in Class 11 (HSSC-I) and scored 80% or more in their board exams. You cannot apply if you already went to an orientation run by another university or NGO. An income affidavit is not accepted.
howToApply: Fill the short Stage 1 pre-application online at talenthunt.iba.edu.pk. For the 2028 admission cycle it is open from 7 October 2026 to 1 February 2027.
If you are selected in Stage 1, you get a link to the Stage 2 detailed application (1 to 30 March 2027) with documents.
Your documents are checked. Shortlisted students join a 3-week orientation at IBA Karachi (English and Maths). Accommodation may be given during the program. You must attend at least 90% of classes.
Take the IBA Aptitude Test.
If you pass, the IBA Scholarship Committee decides who gets an NTHP scholarship. Joining NTHP does not promise a scholarship.

universities.name: Lahore University of Management Sciences
universities.about: LUMS is a top private university in Lahore with business, science, engineering, humanities and law schools. It says about 25% of its students get financial support.
admissionSteps: Check the important dates at admission.lums.edu.pk/critical-dates-all-programmes.
Fill the online admission application at admission.lums.edu.pk. Tick the box that you want financial aid, and pay the processing fee by the deadline (UG online deadline listed as 20 January 2027).
After that, the financial aid application opens in the same portal. Submit it with all documents by its deadline.
Take the admission test that LUMS asks for and follow the next steps on the portal.

hostel.notes: LUMS has on-campus hostels. The National Outreach Programme covers accommodation. Official undergraduate hostel fees were not found; the hostel fees we saw (PKR 98,800 per semester double, PKR 71,900 triple) are on graduate fee pages only.

aid.name: LUMS Financial Aid (need-based tuition waiver + interest-free loan)
aid.amount: 20% to 100% of tuition, plus semester registration and lab fees. It is a mix of a waiver (no need to pay back) and an interest-free loan (must be paid back).
aid.whoCanApply: Students with good grades who show financial need. It is checked again every year.
howToApply: On the online admission form, say you want financial aid, submit it and pay the fee by the deadline.
The financial aid form then opens on the admission portal. Talk to your parents and gather income proof.
Submit the full form with all documents from the Document Checklist by the deadline. Information without official proof is not accepted.
The Office of Financial Aid checks your papers and may ask for more.
The Financial Aid Committee decides and tells you. Aid is for one year; returning students must reapply every year.

aid.name: Syed Babar Ali Hundred for Hundred Qarz-e-Hasna Fund
aid.amount: Interest-free loan (amount not stated)
aid.whoCanApply: Students with demonstrated financial need, from academic year 2026-27.
howToApply: Apply through the LUMS financial aid process.
Ask the Office of Financial Aid: helpdeskofa@lums.edu.pk, +92-42-3560-8000 ext. 2178.

aid.name: 100 Undergraduate Merit Scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Top-ranked new undergraduate applicants with outstanding grades.
howToApply: Apply for admission. LUMS picks top-ranked applicants.

aid.name: National Outreach Programme (NOP)
aid.amount: Full support: admission, tuition, registration, lab charges, accommodation, meals and a stipend.
aid.whoCanApply: Talented students from anywhere in Pakistan with financial need and at least 80% marks in Matric (or equal in O-Levels). Apply while you are in the first year of Intermediate or A-Levels.
howToApply: Apply online for the Summer Coaching Session at nopscs.lums.edu.pk while you are in first-year Intermediate / A-Levels. For the 2026-27 cycle: opens 1 November 2026, online deadline 23 February 2027, documents due 25 February 2027.
If shortlisted, spend 2 weeks at LUMS in the summer. LUMS pays all costs except travel. (Results by 30 June 2027.)
Apply for LUMS admission at admissions.lums.edu.pk. LUMS pays the application and test fees for SCS students.
Take the LUMS entrance test.
If you get in on merit, LUMS checks your financial need and decides on the full NOP scholarship. Coming to the coaching session does not promise admission or a scholarship.

aid.name: LUMS-PEEF Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Talented, deserving students who meet both PEEF's and LUMS's rules.
howToApply: Ask the LUMS Office of Financial Aid how to apply.

aid.name: LUMS-PHEC Honhaar Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: High-achieving students who meet the Punjab HEC Honhaar rules.
howToApply: Apply on the Punjab HEC Honhaar portal: honhaarscholarship.punjabhec.gov.pk.

aid.name: KP Chief Minister Educational Endowment Fund (CMEEF)
aid.whoCanApply: Students from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (merit-cum-affordability).
howToApply: Ask the LUMS Office of Financial Aid.

universities.name: Sukkur IBA University
universities.about: Sukkur IBA University is a public university in Sukkur, Sindh, offering BBA, BS, engineering and education degrees. It has run a Talent Hunt Program for students from poor areas since 2007.
admissionSteps: See the undergraduate programs and the Admission Procedures PDF on the Sukkur IBA admissions page.
Apply online at applyadmission.iba-suk.edu.pk.
Take the Sukkur IBA admission test and follow the instructions sent to you.
After you join, look out for the Financial Assistance Program notice from the Financial Aid Office (CDC).

hostel.notes: On-campus hostels for male and female students. Mostly shared rooms, some single rooms. Mess (food) facility is separate.

costs.otherNotes: Undergraduate tuition is PKR 106,000 per semester; the fee sheet says each later semester is PKR 106,000, so 2 semesters = PKR 212,000 a year. First-time extra charges: admission fee PKR 20,000 + refundable library security PKR 2,000 (total PKR 128,000 at admission). Students in BBA, BS CS/SE, BEE and BSAF who pay on their own get a PKR 9,000 fee waiver; some other programs get PKR 49,400. Hostel charges for 2025-26: single PKR 36,000, double PKR 30,000, triple PKR 25,000 - the sheet does not say if this is per semester or per year, so we did not give a yearly number. If you live at home, you do not pay hostel charges.

aid.name: National Talent Hunt Program (NTHP) - OGDC and Sukkur IBA
aid.amount: Fully funded: no tuition, free hostel, free transport, free books and study material, and Rs. 5,000 for living expenses.
aid.whoCanApply: Students from selected districts in Sindh, Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab (Gujjar Khan), Gilgit-Baltistan and Azad Kashmir. Check the Eligible Districts list on the NTHP site.
howToApply: Check the eligible districts and dates on nthp.iba-suk.edu.pk.
Apply online at applyadmission.iba-suk.edu.pk.
Take the entrance test. About 340 students join a 6-month foundation semester (English, Maths, ICT).
The top 200 students are offered fully funded admission to regular degree programs at Sukkur IBA.
Questions: nthp@iba-suk.edu.pk, 0333-1116931 / 0333-1116932.

aid.name: STS Scholarship Program (Financial Assistance Program 2026-27)
aid.amount: Tuition fee and hostel fee (100 slots)
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduates enrolled in 2026-27 from any province, CGPA at least 2.50, monthly family income up to Rs. 150,000.
howToApply: Fill the Financial Assistance Form and attach all documents.
Submit it to the Financial Aid Office, Room 113, Academic Block-II.
Also fill the Google Form given on the notice.
The Institution Scholarship Award Committee decides. Deadline for 2026-27 was 5 October 2026 - watch for the next notice.

aid.name: Alumni Zakat Scholarship Program
aid.amount: Tuition fee, hostel fee and stipend (100 slots)
aid.whoCanApply: Needy Pakistani Muslim students who are Zakat Mustahiq, with monthly family income up to Rs. 43,000.
howToApply: Fill the Financial Assistance Form with documents.
Also fill an attested Zakat Declaration Form (this is required).
Submit to the Financial Aid Office, Room 113, Academic Block-II, and fill the Google Form.

aid.name: Sindh Bank Scholarship Program
aid.amount: Admission and tuition fees, hostel fees and stipend (5 slots). Income groups: up to Rs. 1.5 million a year (80% of awards), Rs. 1.5-2.5 million (10%), Rs. 2.5-6 million (10%).
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduates in the 2026-27 intake with CGPA at least 2.50.
howToApply: Apply with the same Financial Assistance Form at the Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: SANA FAME Scholarship
aid.amount: Tuition fee and hostel fee (2 slots)
aid.whoCanApply: Fall 2025-26 undergraduates, monthly family income up to Rs. 120,000, at least 70% in Matric and Intermediate, CGPA at least 2.75.
howToApply: Apply with the Financial Assistance Form at the Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: Sindh Insurance Limited Scholarship
aid.amount: Tuition fees and book allowance (1 slot)
aid.whoCanApply: Students who keep 85% or a 3.5 CGPA through the degree.
howToApply: Apply with the Financial Assistance Form at the Financial Aid Office.

universities.name: Forman Christian College (A Chartered University)
universities.about: Forman Christian College is a historic private university in Lahore offering many bachelor's degrees in business, sciences and humanities. In 2025-26 it planned to give over Rs. 525 million in aid to more than 2,800 students.
admissionSteps: Apply for admission through the FCCU admissions website.
Take the Forman Entrance Admission Test (FEAT / Accuplacer). Your T-Score combines your past marks and this test.
To be considered for a merit scholarship, apply no later than the July FEAT cycle.
After you accept your admission, apply for need-based financial aid (see steps below).

hostel.notes: Limited hostel space for male and female students who come from outside Lahore. Rooms are given first-come-first-served: boys for 2 years (4 semesters), girls for 4 years. Hostel dues and compulsory mess (food) charges are paid in 4 installments.

aid.name: Need-Based Financial Aid
aid.whoCanApply: Admitted students who cannot afford fees. You can apply even if you have another scholarship.
howToApply: Optional: with an admission offer, visit the Financial Aid & Scholarships Office with the form and documents for an early (provisional) assessment.
After you accept admission, email financialaid@fccollege.edu.pk from your FCCU email ID to ask for form access.
The office sends you a username, password, form link and document checklist.
Fill the online form, print it, attach all documents and submit it to the Financial Aid & Scholarships Office (in person or by courier) before the deadline in the email.

aid.name: Merit Scholarships (T-Score)
aid.amount: 25% of tuition for T-Score 69; 50% for T-Score 70+. Rector's (100%) and Vice Rector's (75%) scholarships for one student each, by interview.
aid.whoCanApply: New students with high T-Scores who apply by the July FEAT cycle.
howToApply: Apply and take the FEAT by the July cycle.
Get admission. Eligible students are told by the Financial Aid Office. The offer lapses if not accepted on time.

aid.name: FCCU Women Empowerment Scholarship
aid.amount: Up to 10 fully funded tuition + hostel scholarships (meals not included), 2025-26
aid.whoCanApply: First-generation female students with financial need and domicile of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Sindh, Gilgit-Baltistan (Chitral and Kalash) or Kashmir, joining a 4-year bachelor's program.
howToApply: Pass the FCCU admission test with a high score.
High scorers are shortlisted and called for an interview.
If not selected, apply for FCCU's normal need-based aid.

aid.name: Work-Study Program
aid.amount: Pay for hours worked on campus, adjusted against tuition
aid.whoCanApply: FCCU students; aid recipients are encouraged to apply.
howToApply: Apply online. The Financial Aid Office shares eligible names with hiring departments.

aid.name: Zakat Fund
aid.whoCanApply: Underprivileged Muslim students.
howToApply: Ask the Financial Aid & Scholarships Office.

aid.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) at FCCU
aid.amount: 20 partial tuition scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab domicile, at least 60% in last exam, parents' monthly income Rs. 60,000 or less, full-time student in the same year you passed, no other scholarship.
howToApply: Ask the FCCU Financial Aid Office, which helps students apply.

aid.name: Balochistan Educational Endowment Fund (BEEF)
aid.amount: Partial tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Balochistan domicile, at least 60% marks or 3.0 GPA, no other scholarship.
howToApply: Ask the FCCU Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: HEC scholarships (help to apply)
aid.whoCanApply: Students who meet HEC rules.
howToApply: Ask the FCCU Financial Aid Office for help applying.

universities.name: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST University), Karachi
universities.about: SZABIST University in Karachi is a private university offering BBA, Accounting & Finance, Computer Science, Media, Social Sciences and more. Its ERFA office handles scholarships and loans.
admissionSteps: Check that you meet the rules: Intermediate / A-Levels with at least 50% for BBA and most BS programs.
Apply online at admissions.szabist.edu.pk and pay the Rs. 2,000 application fee.
Take the SZABIST entrance test and the interview / group discussion.
If admitted, contact the ERFA office about scholarships and loans.

hostel.notes: We did not find official hostel information for the Karachi campus.

costs.academicYear: Current (page does not show the year; checked Oct 2026)
costs.otherNotes: BBA tuition: Rs. 9,500 per credit hour = Rs. 180,500 per semester (19 credit hours). 2 semesters = Rs. 361,000 a year. Other programs differ, e.g. BS Accounting & Finance Rs. 190,000 and BS Computer Science Rs. 195,500 per semester. Extra: admission fee Rs. 30,000 (once), refundable security Rs. 15,000 (once), student activity Rs. 1,500 per semester, course registration Rs. 500 per course, exam fee Rs. 500 per course, lab charges Rs. 3,000-5,000.

aid.name: SZABIST Need-Based Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Students in any degree program except PhD with annual family income below Rs. 1,500,000. Continuing students need a CGPA of at least 2.5.
howToApply: Watch the SZABIST Announcements page (the 2025-26 round for new students ran 31 Oct - 28 Nov 2025).
Get the form from the ERFA Department or the website and fill it carefully.
Submit it with all documents to ERFA by the deadline.
You may be called for an interview.
ERFA tells you the decision. Contact: erfa@szabist.edu.pk, +92 21 35823433 ext. 371 / 374.

aid.name: SZABIST Merit-Based Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Students with semester GPA 3.70 or more on a full course load, from the 2nd semester onward.
howToApply: Contact the ERFA Department.

aid.name: Chief Minister SZABIST Merit & Need-Based Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduates (not LLB) with monthly family income up to Rs. 125,000 and CGPA above 3.0.
howToApply: Contact the ERFA Department for the form.

aid.name: Sindh Education Endowment Fund (SEEF) Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Sindh domicile and PRC, at least 60% in Intermediate (or GPA 2.5), annual family income up to Rs. 6,000,000, in a SEEF-approved subject.
howToApply: See seef.sindh.gov.pk and contact ERFA.

aid.name: Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna (interest-free loan)
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduate or graduate students (not Media Science) with CGPA at least 2.5.
howToApply: See ihsantrust.org and contact ERFA.

aid.name: TCF Financial Assistance
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduates who studied at a The Citizens Foundation (TCF) school or college.
howToApply: Contact ERFA and TCF (tcf.org.pk).

aid.name: Balochistan Education Endowment Fund (BEEF)
aid.whoCanApply: Balochistan domicile, CGPA 3.0+, no other scholarship (not LLB or PhD).
howToApply: See beef.org.pk and contact ERFA.

aid.name: EDUFI Study Now, Pay Later
aid.whoCanApply: Students with an admission offer or already studying at SZABIST who agree to a repayment plan. (This is a paid loan product, not a grant.)
howToApply: See edufi.tech and contact ERFA.

universities.name: University of Karachi
universities.about: The University of Karachi is one of Pakistan's largest public universities, with 9 faculties and 50+ departments. Its business school (KUBS) offers BBA.
admissionSteps: Read the Prospectus 2027 and the eligibility rules on uokadmission.edu.pk. You need at least 45% in Intermediate.
Create a portal account and fill the online admission form (up to 5 department choices).
For test-based programs like BBA, take the entrance test.
Check the merit lists on the website, pay the fee and complete enrolment.

hostel.notes: The prospectus says the Student Handbook covers hostels. We did not find official hostel fees or rules.

costs.otherNotes: The official 'Fee Structure Morning & Evening Programme Admissions 2027' list shows one fee per program, e.g. BBA (morning) Rs. 123,000, BS Computer Science (morning) Rs. 94,500, BS Economics (morning) Rs. 37,500, BBA (evening) Rs. 132,000. The list does not say if this is per year or the fee paid at admission, so we did not put a yearly number. Morning program fees are much lower than evening ones.

aid.name: KU Need-Based Scholarships (SFAO)
aid.amount: University tuition for 1 or 2 semesters, depending on funds and your results
aid.whoCanApply: Morning program undergraduate students only.
howToApply: Get admission first - you cannot apply before.
Watch the official scholarship page (uok.edu.pk/sfao-scholarships) every week for advertisements.
Download and print the form, fill it, and also fill the online data link given on the form.
Submit the printed form with all documents in person to SFAO, Room 4, Old Administration Building, by the deadline. Online-only submission is not accepted.
If you have no income proof, attach a written application and an affidavit / bank statement / utility bills as the FAQ explains.

aid.name: Need-cum-Merit Zakat & Ushr Scholarship (Govt of Sindh) 2026-27
aid.amount: Tuition fee plus a small stipend (when funds are available)
aid.whoCanApply: Regular Muslim students (Zakat Mustahiq) with permanent residence in Sindh, CGPA at least 2.50 with no failed or repeated courses, total annual family income not over Rs. 500,000, parents not government servants, and no other scholarship.
howToApply: Download the Zakat form from uok.edu.pk/sfao-scholarships and fill the Google Form.
Get your Zakat Istehqaq Certificate verified and stamped by the District Zakat Officer or Chairman, District Zakat Committee.
Make an affidavit on Rs. 50 or 100 stamp paper, signed by a parent and attested by a Notary Public.
Attach CNIC copies, unpaid fee voucher, ID card copy, income proof, 3 months of utility bills, transcripts and semester proforma.
Submit at SFAO, Room 4, Old Admin Building, 10 AM-1 PM. Deadline: 5 November 2026.

aid.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
aid.amount: As per HEC policy and funds
aid.whoCanApply: Morning program, on-campus regular students whose family income is within Rs. 45,000 (per the KU FAQ), when SFAO advertises it.
howToApply: Wait for the SFAO advertisement and apply on the given form.
Current holders must submit a renewal form each year (2026-27 renewals: 2-16 November 2026 by faculty).

aid.name: Ihsan Trust Interest-Free Loan
aid.whoCanApply: KU students, including evening program students. You can apply any time of year, even right after submitting your admission form.
howToApply: Get the form from the official scholarship page (uok.edu.pk/sfao-scholarships).
Submit it to SFAO.

aid.name: Merit-Based Scholarships
aid.amount: A fixed award amount
aid.whoCanApply: 3rd-year and final-year undergraduate students (morning program).
howToApply: Watch SFAO advertisements on the scholarship page.

aid.name: Other donor programs (UKAHA, Haier, Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal, SEEF, BEEF, PEF)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program's advertisement.
