howToApply: Check uok.edu.pk/sfao-scholarships for each notice and form.

universities.name: University of the Punjab
universities.about: The University of the Punjab in Lahore is Pakistan's oldest and one of its largest public universities. Its Institute of Business Administration (IBA-PU) and Hailey College offer business degrees.
admissionSteps: Find your program on pu.edu.pk/program and read its admission criteria.
Apply online through 'Apply Online (On-Campus Programs)' on the PU website during the admission dates.
If your program has an entry test, check the schedule and results on admissions.pu.edu.pk.
Check the merit lists on admissions.pu.edu.pk, then pay your fee by the due date.

hostel.notes: PU has 28 hostels (16 for boys, 12 for girls) with about 7,000 students. Hostels are mainly for students from outside Lahore. Rooms are allotted by the Chairman Hall Council. Hostel fees were not found.

aid.name: PU Students Financial Aid Centre (many need and merit scholarships)
aid.whoCanApply: Enrolled PU students. PU says no deserving or meritorious student will be refused because of money. It lists 30+ programs, e.g. HEC Need-Based, PEEF, Taleem Mumkin, Allah Waly Trust, Dr. Badar ud Din Needy Scholarship, Children of Shuhada, District Scholarship.
howToApply: Check scholarships.pu.edu.pk for open scholarships.
Contact the Students Financial Aid Centre: sfao@pu.edu.pk, 042-99231110.
Apply on each scholarship's own form before its deadline.

aid.name: CM Punjab Honhaar Undergraduate Scholarship
aid.amount: 100% of tuition fee (Punjab HEC page does not mention hostel or stipend)
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab domicile. First-semester students in 2026 at a selected public university need at least 70% (science) or 65% (arts) in Intermediate, and monthly family income below Rs. 350,000 (with an e-stamp affidavit). Only selected subjects and universities count.
howToApply: Check eligibility on honhaarscholarship.punjabhec.gov.pk.
Prepare your personal, school and family income details.
Make the income affidavit on e-stamp paper (sample on the site).
Register and apply online on the PHEC portal. Help: honhaar@punjabhec.gov.pk.

aid.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Financially needy PU students when announced (PU announced 250 awards for 2025-26).
howToApply: Watch PU scholarship notices and apply through the Financial Aid Centre.

aid.name: PEEF scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab students who meet PEEF rules.
howToApply: See the PEEF notice on scholarships.pu.edu.pk.

aid.name: Punjab Zakat education stipend
aid.whoCanApply: Deserving students under Punjab Zakat rules.
howToApply: PU links to zakat.punjab.gov.pk/educationgeneral - follow the steps there.

universities.name: Quaid-i-Azam University
universities.about: Quaid-i-Azam University in Islamabad is a top public research university. Its Quaid-i-Azam School of Management Sciences (QASMS) offers business degrees.
admissionSteps: Read the undergraduate admission notice on qau.edu.pk (seats are on Regular or Self-Finance basis).
Apply through the Online Application System on the QAU website.
Pay the processing fee (Rs. 2,860 for Fall 2026) online through Kuickpay or 1-Bill and upload the payment proof.
Check the merit lists. Ask the Scholarships Office about aid after you are admitted.

hostel.notes: QAU has hostels; BS students can stay for up to 8 semesters. The official hostel charges page lists Fall 2026 local-student charges (about Rs. 39,370 at entry, including a Rs. 6,300 refundable security) but we could not open the page directly to confirm details, so no yearly number is given.

aid.name: QAU Financial Assistance / Need-based aid (OSFA)
aid.whoCanApply: Enrolled QAU students with limited money. Orphans and students from far-flung or poor areas get special consideration.
howToApply: Watch scholarship notices on qau.edu.pk/financial-assistancescholarships/.
Contact the Office of Scholarship and Financial Assistance: scholarship@qau.edu.pk, (+92) 51 9064-4091.
Submit the form and documents. University scholarship committees decide.

aid.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Undergraduate students with financial need, as judged by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee.
howToApply: Apply when QAU's scholarship office announces it.

aid.name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Poor students; past rounds gave priority to orphans and disabled students. Self-finance students were not eligible in the Spring 2024 round.
howToApply: Apply when QAU's scholarship office announces it.

aid.name: Provincial endowment funds (PEEF, KP CMEEF, BEEF, Sindh Endowment Fund)
aid.whoCanApply: Students from the matching province who meet each fund's rules.
howToApply: See qau.edu.pk/provincial-endowment-scholarships/ and contact the scholarship office.

universities.name: Government College University, Lahore
universities.about: GCU Lahore (founded 1864) is a famous public university in Lahore. It offers BBA, BS Economics, BS Business Analytics and many science and arts degrees.
admissionSteps: Apply on the GCU online admission portal: www.gcuonline.pk.
Pay the processing fee of Rs. 1,000 per subject at any UBL bank branch (mobile app / UBL Omni not accepted).
Admission is on open merit using your Intermediate Part-I marks (entry tests only for some programs like LLB and engineering).
If you are on the merit list, bring your form and documents for interview / document check, then pay the dues on time.

hostel.notes: GCU's fee rules mention hostel security, so hostels exist, but we did not find official hostel fees or rules.

costs.otherNotes: BBA (Morning) dues: Rs. 96,950 + Rs. 66,950 for Year 1 (2 installments) = Rs. 163,900; whole 4-year program Rs. 569,100. BS Economics or BS Business Analytics (Morning): Rs. 70,050 + 43,550 = Rs. 113,600 in Year 1 (program total Rs. 378,400). Evening programs cost more (BBA Evening Year 1 = Rs. 200,000). These are total university dues, not tuition alone. If yearly fees go over Rs. 200,000, 5% advance tax applies.

aid.name: GCU Financial Aid
aid.whoCanApply: GCU students whose father's / family monthly income is not more than Rs. 70,000. You must keep a CGPA of 2.5 and not get 2 or more F grades. You cannot hold another scholarship at the same time.
howToApply: You cannot get aid at the time of admission. First pay at least the first semester fee (orphans: half of it).
Wait for the Student Financial Aid Office (SFAO) to announce the application.
Fill the prescribed form with complete supporting documents.
Attend the interview. The Financial Aid Committee decides based on need, merit and funds.
If approved, pay any remaining dues within 15 days. Aid continues for the whole program if you meet the rules. Contact: sfao@gcu.edu.pk, 042-99213515.

aid.name: CM Punjab Honhaar Undergraduate Scholarship
aid.amount: 100% of tuition fee (Punjab HEC page does not mention hostel or stipend)
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab domicile. First-semester students in 2026 at a selected public university need at least 70% (science) or 65% (arts) in Intermediate, and monthly family income below Rs. 350,000 (with an e-stamp affidavit). Only selected subjects and universities count.
howToApply: Check eligibility on honhaarscholarship.punjabhec.gov.pk.
Prepare your personal, school and family income details.
Make the income affidavit on e-stamp paper (sample on the site).
Register and apply online on the PHEC portal. Help: honhaar@punjabhec.gov.pk.

aid.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students who meet HEC rules.
howToApply: Apply when the GCU SFAO announces it.

aid.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
aid.whoCanApply: Punjab students who meet PEEF rules.
howToApply: Apply when the GCU SFAO announces it.

aid.name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal, SEEF, BEEF, KP CMEEF and other donor scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program.
howToApply: Ask the GCU SFAO.

aid.name: Kinship fee concession
aid.whoCanApply: Students whose real brother or sister is also studying at GCU, from the 2nd semester.
howToApply: Get the Fee Concession Form from the Treasurer's Office Fee Section and submit it by the due date.

universities.name: Institute of Business Management
universities.about: IoBM is a private business-focused university in Karachi (Korangi Creek) offering BBA, BS, engineering and media degrees. In 2025-26, 2,130 students got financial assistance or scholarships.
admissionSteps: Read the undergraduate requirements on iobm.edu.pk/undergraduate-requirements/.
Apply online at admissions.iobm.edu.pk.
Take the IoBM admission test (weak scores may mean extra remedial courses).
Once you get an admission offer, apply for Educational Assistance if you need money help.

hostel.notes: We did not find official hostel information. The Outreach Program gives free boarding only during its 4-week training.

costs.otherNotes: All bachelor's programs: Rs. 29,400 per course (Rs. 9,800 per credit hour). Full load = Rs. 176,400 tuition + Rs. 10,000 registration = Rs. 186,400 per semester. 2 semesters = Rs. 352,800 tuition a year (Rs. 372,800 with registration). One-time admission fee Rs. 50,000. Extra lab charges for BS CS / SE and BE Electrical (Rs. 58,800) and Media Studies (Rs. 25,000 per semester). 3% Sindh sales tax if yearly fees exceed Rs. 500,000.

aid.name: Educational Assistance on Need / Need-cum-Merit
aid.whoCanApply: Students from families with money problems. To keep it, bachelor's students need semester GPA and CGPA of 2.50 (need) or GPA 2.80 / CGPA 2.50 (need-cum-merit) with at least 14 credit hours.
howToApply: Get an admission offer first.
Email financial.assistance@iobm.edu.pk or visit the Financial Assistance and Scholarship Office (Administration building).
Bring documents: income proof of all earners (or tax return), paid utility bills, rent agreement if renting, siblings' fee challans, proof of any other income.
Have a short interview. A house survey is done to check your need.
The Finance & Planning Committee decides based on need and grades.

aid.name: Merit Scholarship
aid.amount: 50% of tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Bachelor's students with semester GPA 3.60 and CGPA 3.50 (minimum 14 credit hours). Renewed each semester if you keep the GPA.
howToApply: No house survey needed; it is based on your grades.

aid.name: IoBM Outreach Program
aid.amount: No registration or tuition fee (100% waiver) plus free transport in the city. Free training, boarding and lodging during the 4-week preparation.
aid.whoCanApply: Less privileged students from Tharparkar, Umerkot, Badin, Thatta, Sujawal, Sanghar, Dadu and Jamshoro with at least 60% in HSC Pre-Engineering (for the Electrical Engineering program). Keep CGPA 2.5 or more.
howToApply: Watch for the newspaper advertisement (admission once a year for Spring).
Fill the online application form; print the copy emailed to you and send it with SSC and HSC marksheets, domicile, father's/guardian's income proof and 2 photos.
Take the screening test.
If shortlisted, attend the free 4-week training at IoBM (English, Maths, Communication).
Take the IoBM aptitude test and interview. Successful students are admitted on merit-cum-need.

aid.name: TCF Alumni Program
aid.amount: 100% fee waiver plus free transport
aid.whoCanApply: Alumni of The Citizens Foundation (TCF) schools, on merit.
howToApply: Contact IoBM admissions / TCF.

aid.name: Lucky Cement Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Meritorious students with financial need.
howToApply: The Admissions Office gives forms to needy students after a first interview.

aid.name: Sports Scholarship
aid.amount: 50% of tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Students with past sports achievements who play for IoBM teams.
howToApply: Apply; the HoD Sports must endorse your application.

universities.name: Aga Khan University Medical College
universities.about: AKU is a private, not-for-profit university in Karachi with its own hospital. It says almost half of its students get financial help.
admissionSteps: Read the MBBS admission rules on the AKU admissions website.
Apply online and take the AKU entrance steps it asks for.
If you get an offer, look at your offer package. It shows the deadline for the financial assistance form.
If your family cannot pay, send the financial assistance form before that deadline.

hostel.notes: AKU has an on-campus hostel for MBBS students. Fee for Pakistani students is Rs. 45,000 per month (MBBS 2027). Students in the on-campus hostel also pay an extra Rs. 19,000 for air-conditioning (the sheet does not say how often).

costs.otherNotes: The yearly fee shown is tuition (Rs. 1,704,000) plus the University Fee (Rs. 1,872,000). On top of tuition, AKU also charges a University Fee of Rs. 1,872,000 every year, so tuition plus University Fee is Rs. 3,576,000 a year in 2027. One-time costs: admission fee Rs. 255,000, refundable security deposit Rs. 19,000, graduation fee Rs. 34,000, physical exam Rs. 23,000, immunization Rs. 11,000. Other yearly costs: health fee Rs. 32,000, activity fee Rs. 5,000. Fees go up each year (tuition Rs. 2,499,000 by 2031). The hostel fee is Rs. 45,000 a month. We multiplied it by 12 months to get Rs. 540,000 a year, but AKU does not give a yearly figure. Living at home: you skip the hostel fee and the air-conditioning charge, but you still pay all the other fees. AKU says all fees except tuition and University Fee may change.

aid.name: AKU Financial Assistance (need-based grant + interest-free loan)
covers: tuition and other fees (AKU does not list exactly what is covered)
aid.amount: Depends on your family's need. It is a mix of a grant (free money) and a loan. AKU does not publish fixed amounts.
aid.whoCanApply: Students who got admission to AKU but cannot pay the costs. AKU checks your family's need. It also expects you to pay part yourself and to look for other funding first.
howToApply: Get admission first. Your offer package tells you the deadline.
Fill in the Financial Assistance Application Form for new students: https://www.aku.edu/admissions/fees-and-funding/Documents/fa-application-new.pdf
Add all the supporting documents it asks for. Late or incomplete forms are not accepted.
AKU may interview you or your parents and may check your documents.
A committee decides the amount. It does not see your name.
If you disagree, you can appeal one time, with new information.
Apply again every year. For current students the deadline is the last working day of February.
Questions: Student Financial Counselling and Assistance Office, student.fa@aku.edu, +92 21 3486 4469.

aid.name: AKU student loan repayment and remission
covers: the loan part of your financial assistance
aid.amount: No interest, but there is a yearly 5% administrative charge from the date of the award. MBBS students start repaying 2 years after they graduate. If you work full-time at AKU or study more at AKU after graduating, up to 50% of the loan can be forgiven.
aid.whoCanApply: Students who got a loan as part of AKU Financial Assistance.
howToApply: The loan comes with your financial assistance award. There is no separate form.
To get part of the loan forgiven, register with the Student Finance Office within 1 month of starting work or study at AKU.
After each full year, send a certificate showing 1 year of service or study.

universities.name: Shifa College of Medicine (Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University)
universities.about: Shifa College of Medicine is the medical college of Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University in Islamabad. It works with Shifa International Hospital.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and take MDCAT.
Download the MBBS prospectus from the STMU admissions page.
Apply online before the deadline in the prospectus. Take the STMU entrance test and interview if asked.
If you are on the merit list, pay the fee by bank draft or pay order within 3 working days.

hostel.notes: Hostel rooms are limited, so ask early. Late applicants may not get a place. Local students pay Rs. 825,550 a year. This covers room, food (mess) and utilities.

costs.otherNotes: First-year local fees: tuition Rs. 2,020,000, admission fee Rs. 40,000 (one time), refundable security Rs. 70,000, University Fee Rs. 40,000 a year. Total for year 1: Rs. 2,170,000. Exam, convocation, PM&DC registration and taxes are extra. The prospectus quotes the PM&DC rule: you may pay tuition every 3 months, every 6 months or once a year. Paying 6 months ahead gets a 2% discount, and paying a full year ahead gets 4%. Living at home: you skip the Rs. 825,550 hostel charge, but you pay your own food and travel.

aid.name: STMU Scholarships and other funds (Financial Assistance Committee)
aid.whoCanApply: STMU students. The page says aid is need-cum-merit. You can hold only one award at a time.
howToApply: Ask the Student Affairs Office for the prescribed financial assistance form.
Apply before the academic session starts (STMU FAQ).
The University Financial Assistance Committee chooses who gets aid.

aid.name: Installment payment
aid.amount: At most 2 installments. The first must be at least 50% and is paid before classes start. Only up to 10% of a batch can use it.
aid.whoCanApply: Students who cannot pay the full fee at once. Decided on need-cum-merit.
howToApply: Fill in the installment form before classes start.
The Departmental Financial Assistance Committee decides.

aid.name: Fee waiver if father or guardian dies
aid.amount: 25% of tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Students whose father or legal guardian dies during the program.
howToApply: Contact Student Affairs / the Financial Assistance Committee.

aid.name: Position-holder prize money
aid.amount: 15% (1st), 10% (2nd), 5% (3rd) of that year's tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Top 3 students who score at least 80% overall in the annual professional exam.
howToApply: No form is needed. It is given based on results.

aid.name: Sibling discount
aid.amount: 20% of tuition for a second sibling
aid.whoCanApply: A second brother or sister studying at the college.
howToApply: Tell the admissions or accounts office.

aid.name: Government and trust programs (PEEF, KPK government MOU, sponsors)
aid.whoCanApply: STMU says its Treasurer's office tries to get eligible students into schemes such as the Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) and a KPK government MOU. It also seeks help from sponsors and trusts.
howToApply: Ask the STMU Treasurer's office or Student Affairs which schemes you may be eligible for.

universities.name: Ziauddin Medical College (Ziauddin University)
universities.about: Ziauddin University is a private university in Karachi with medical colleges and hospitals. It has a Financial Assistance Committee led by the Vice Chancellor.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and take MDCAT.
Apply online on the ZU admission portal.
Follow the ZU merit and interview steps shown on the portal.

aid.name: Need-Based Tuition Fee Assistance
aid.amount: 10% to 50% of tuition, depending on your need and the money available
aid.whoCanApply: Full-time students from the second year onward. It is not given in the first year. Students whose family money situation got worse after admission get preference. Students with an F grade or repeat courses cannot apply.
howToApply: Finish your first year.
Apply through the student portal or on the prescribed form.
Add documents that show your family's financial need.
The Financial Assistance Committee scores your need and compares it with other applicants.
Aid is given for 1 year at a time. To continue, apply again.
If you disagree, complain to the Registrar Office within 15 days of the result.

aid.name: Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
aid.amount: 25% of tuition for the top student. In batches of more than 100 students, the top 2% get 20%, 15% or 10%.
aid.whoCanApply: Current students with the top position, with at least 65% in annual-system colleges. From the end of first year. Not for the graduating batch.
howToApply: You do not need to apply. The college keeps the record.

aid.name: Scholarships to new admissions in selected programs
aid.amount: Partial tuition. It may continue if you do well.
aid.whoCanApply: New students ranked high in the ZU admission evaluation, in programs chosen by the university. The policy does not say if MBBS is included.
howToApply: No separate form. You are considered when you apply for admission.

universities.name: FMH College of Medicine & Dentistry (Fatima Memorial System)
universities.about: FMH College of Medicine & Dentistry is a not-for-profit college run by a trust, linked with Fatima Memorial Hospital in Lahore. It says its income goes back into the college, including Qarz-e-Hasna for deserving students.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) with at least 60% marks.
Pass MDCAT with at least 55% for MBBS.
Apply through the Punjab private medical college admission process (UHS). Merit is 50% MDCAT, 40% FSc and 10% Matric.
When you are selected, pay the fee by the due date.

hostel.notes: There are separate hostels for male and female students. Places depend on space, and students from outside Lahore get preference. The fee sheet says hostel and mess charges are 'as per actual'. No fixed amount is given.

costs.otherNotes: Year 1 annual dues are Rs. 2,490,000. They rise each year to Rs. 3,026,610 in year 5, for a total of Rs. 13,758,820 for MBBS. Taxes and charges from the government, university or regulator are extra. Hostel, mess, transport (home to college) and health insurance are charged 'as per actual'. Living at home: you avoid hostel and mess costs, but you may pay for the college's private pick-and-drop transport.

aid.name: Qarz-e-Hasna (interest-free loan) and scholarships via Student Affairs
aid.whoCanApply: Deserving students. The prospectus says the trust's income goes towards Qarz-e-Hasna for deserving students. The Department of Student Affairs handles scholarships, financial assistance and fee issues.
howToApply: Visit the Department of Student Affairs in the college building.
Ask about scholarships, Qarz-e-Hasna and the fee installment policy (https://www.fmhcmd.edu.pk/fee-installment-policy/).

universities.name: Lahore Medical & Dental College
universities.about: LMDC was the first private medical college in Punjab, started in 1997. It is affiliated with the University of Health Sciences (UHS), Lahore.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and MDCAT.
Apply through the UHS admission process for private colleges. In 2025-26, LMDC also took online applications at https://admissions.lmdc.edu.pk
If selected, deposit Rs. 600,000 in the UHS account on time, or you lose the seat.
Fill in the joining report on the UHS portal, then pay the rest of the fee to LMDC.
Bring your documents (IBCC-attested certificates, domicile, MDCAT result, CNIC copies, photos, stamp papers) to Student Affairs.

hostel.notes: Hostels are within walking distance of campus, with separate buildings for men and women and shared or single rooms. There is a mess hall. You pay hostel charges for the whole year, and they are non-refundable. Security of Rs. 5,000 is refundable. The yearly hostel charge is not published.

costs.otherNotes: Year 1: tuition Rs. 2,495,000 plus admission fee Rs. 5,000, for a total of Rs. 2,500,000. Tuition rises 5% a year (and may rise with CPI inflation), reaching Rs. 3,032,688 in year 5. Total for 5 years: Rs. 13,791,450. Extra one-time fees: UHS registration Rs. 24,000 and PMDC registration Rs. 15,000. Living at home: you avoid the hostel charge, which is not published.

universities.name: Isra University (Isra Medical College / Faculty of Clinical Sciences)
universities.about: Isra University is a private university with campuses in Hyderabad, Karachi and Islamabad. It offers MBBS through its Faculty of Clinical Sciences.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and MDCAT.
Apply online through the Isra admissions portal.
Check the fee and test dates on the portal.

hostel.notes: Hostels are off campus. Girls stay in hostels in different parts of the city, with a shuttle to campus. Boys get help finding rented rooms. The hostel forms are from 2013, so we did not use their prices. The page does not say which campus this applies to.

costs.otherNotes: Year 1: tuition Rs. 1,890,000 plus University Fees Rs. 535,000 plus admission fee Rs. 50,000 (non-refundable), for a total of Rs. 2,475,000. Fees rise every year. The year 5 total is Rs. 3,623,648, and the 5-year total is Rs. 15,110,123. Add 3% SRB tax and PMDC registration. The fee page has tabs for Islamabad, Karachi and Hyderabad, and we could not confirm which campus this table is for. Hostel cost is not published, so check before choosing between home and hostel.

aid.name: Isra scholarships, tuition concessions and free-ships (Isra Islamic Foundation and donors)
aid.amount: Full or partial. Limited number.
aid.whoCanApply: Needy and meritorious students. Isra says over 10% of students get some aid.
howToApply: Contact the Isra admissions office and ask about the free-ship and scholarship form.

aid.name: Government of Sindh Endowment Fund scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Poor and meritorious students seeking admission. Isra is on the Sindh Endowment Fund list.
howToApply: Contact the Secretary, Board of Trustees for Endowment Fund, Education Department, Government of Sindh, Karachi.

aid.name: Isra merit scholarships (Chancellor's, Vice Chancellor's, Academic Honor)
aid.amount: 100%, 50% or 25% tuition waiver
aid.whoCanApply: High-merit new students, based on school marks, the Isra admission test (IUAT), an essay and activities. The online form's program list does NOT include MBBS, so it may not apply to MBBS.
howToApply: Fill in the online form at https://apply.isra.edu.pk/scholarship and ask admissions if it covers MBBS.

universities.name: Islamic International Medical College (Riphah International University)
universities.about: IIMC is the medical college of Riphah International University. MBBS is taught at the Al-Mizan Campus in Rawalpindi, with 100 seats.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and MDCAT.
Apply on the Riphah admissions portal (admissions.riphah.edu.pk) when Fall admissions open.
Pay the first-year fee when selected. PM&DC registration is paid separately.

costs.academicYear: Fall intake listed on the site in October 2026 (the page does not name the academic year)
costs.otherNotes: Year 1 for Pakistani students: admission fee Rs. 50,000 plus tuition Rs. 2,400,000, for a total of Rs. 2,450,000. Tentative later years: Rs. 2,640,000 (year 2), Rs. 2,904,000 (year 3), Rs. 3,195,000 (year 4), Rs. 3,515,000 (year 5). Taxes and PM&DC registration are extra. Hostel cost could not be confirmed.

aid.name: Mawakhat Assistantship (need-cum-merit)
aid.whoCanApply: Students who have passed at least one Riphah university exam and can prove hardship. Not for first-term students or students on special or reserved seats. Students at affiliated institutions are not eligible. The MBBS-specific Riphah document says it is for students hit by an unexpected severe event after admission. The general page says you need an SGPA of 3.20 to keep it.
howToApply: Get the financial assistance form from the Finance Department.
Submit it within the first 2 weeks of registration for the term, with 50% of your dues paid.
Your parent or guardian must sign it. Attach proof of financial problems and your results.
If approved, pay the rest within 15 days.
You must do 1 hour of social work as assigned.

aid.name: Wali Assistantship (orphan scholarship)
aid.amount: 50% of tuition each term
aid.whoCanApply: Students whose fee-paying parent dies after admission.
howToApply: Apply to the Fee & Dues office of your campus with proof.

universities.name: Foundation University Medical College (Foundation University School of Health Sciences)
universities.about: FUMC is the medical college of Foundation University, a project of the Fauji Foundation. It is in Islamabad, with Fauji Foundation Hospital.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and MDCAT.
Apply through the FUSH admissions pages.
Pay the fee and security when selected.

hostel.notes: Hostel for male and female students, first come, first served. Rs. 26,000 per month (twin sharing) or Rs. 52,000 per month (single room), paid in advance for the year.

universities.name: Hamdard College of Medicine & Dentistry (Hamdard University)
universities.about: Hamdard College of Medicine & Dentistry is part of Hamdard University's Faculty of Health & Medical Sciences in Karachi.
admissionSteps: Pass FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent) and MDCAT.
Apply online at the Hamdard admission portal.
If you need a loan, collect the Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna form from the Admission Office when you get your offer letter.

hostel.notes: Hamdard has a 'Hostel Life' page, but it gives no MBBS details. The fee page says hostel and mess are charged 'on actual basis'.

costs.otherNotes: Year 1: admission fee Rs. 100,000, enrollment fee Rs. 2,000, tuition Rs. 1,782,500, annual charges Rs. 100,000, for a total of Rs. 1,984,500. Tuition rises each year to Rs. 2,312,172 in year 5 (year 5 total Rs. 2,412,172). The sheet prints the program total as '1,0965,615', which looks like a typo, so add up the yearly totals yourself. Hostel and mess are charged at actual cost (amount not published).

aid.name: Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna (interest-free loan)
aid.whoCanApply: Hamdard students, on a need-cum-merit basis. It is run with Ihsan Trust.
howToApply: Collect the Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna application form, repayment guidelines and agreement from the Hamdard Admission Office.
Submit the filled form at the Admission Office with your admission offer letter and the required documents.
Attend the panel interview by Ihsan Trust.
Repay in easy installments, with no interest.

aid.name: Hardship Scholarship
aid.amount: Up to 50% of tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Students hit by a sudden problem, such as the death of the family's earner, during the year.
howToApply: Get the Fee Concession Form from your faculty or download it from CMS.
Submit it with supporting documents to the Financial Assistance Committee.
If shortlisted, attend a panel interview.

aid.name: Merit Scholarship
aid.amount: Up to 70% of tuition
aid.whoCanApply: Students with 65% marks in the last year (annual system) and no failed subjects.
howToApply: Submit the Fee Concession Form to the Financial Assistance Committee and attend the interview.

aid.name: Sister & Brother Scholarship
aid.amount: 50% for one sibling (the one with the lowest tuition)
aid.whoCanApply: When two or more real siblings study at Hamdard at the same time.
howToApply: Submit the Fee Concession Form.

universities.name: King Edward Medical University
universities.about: KEMU is one of Pakistan's oldest and best-known public medical universities, in Lahore. PM&DC lists it with 350 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (at least 55% for MBBS). Punjab students take the MDCAT run by UHS Lahore.
Make sure you have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Punjab domicile (for open merit seats).
Apply online to UHS Lahore (not to KEMU directly) at publicmbbs.uhs.edu.pk and pay the Rs. 2,000 UHS fee.
List all public medical colleges in your order of preference (put KEMU where you want it). You cannot change the order after the last date.
Check the UHS merit lists. If KEMU gives you a seat, pay the college fee within 3 working days and report to the college in writing.
Keep watching later merit lists: you may be moved ('upgraded') to a college higher on your list.

hostel.notes: KEMU charges hostel fees to boarders. Its 29-04-2024 hostel notification lists, for MBBS 1st to 4th year: utility charges Rs. 29,040 per year, room rent Rs. 1,200 and common room Rs. 500 (total about Rs. 30,740 a year). For final year: Rs. 36,300 + Rs. 1,500 + Rs. 625. Air-conditioning costs extra if you choose it. A hostel welfare fund is charged separately. The 2023-24 fee schedule also lists a refundable hostel security of Rs. 5,000 in first year. Food (mess) costs are not listed.

costs.academicYear: 2026-27 (tuition set by Punjab Government); hostel rates from KEMU notice of 29-04-2024
costs.otherNotes: The Punjab 2026-27 admission policy sets tuition for public MBBS/BDS (open merit) at Rs. 50,000 per year. KEMU's own last published schedule (session 2023-24) showed tuition Rs. 30,000 a year plus university funds; first-year total for a day scholar was about Rs. 54,530 (Rs. 35,030 university fee + Rs. 14,500 funds + Rs. 5,000 PMC registration), and about Rs. 41,630 in later years. Living at home: you pay tuition and college funds only. Living in the hostel: add about Rs. 30,740 a year (years 1-4) plus food. Admitted students in Punjab public colleges also sign a Rs. 3 million surety bond to serve the Punjab Health Department for one year after house job (as shown in the 2025-26 Punjab call letter at AIMC).

aid.name: KEMU Need Based Scholarship
aid.amount: Rs. 6,000 per month (amount can be reviewed by the university)
aid.whoCanApply: MBBS and Allied Health students whose parents' total monthly income is Rs. 60,000 or less (some exceptions possible). Not for self-finance students or students already getting another need-based scholarship. Continues to final year if you keep passing.
howToApply: Watch the KEMU scholarships page for the call for applications.
Fill the prescribed application form.

Attach: CNIC copies of father and mother/guardian, salary slip or income certificate, last 6 months of utility bills, rent agreement (if renting), fee receipts of siblings, and medical bills (if any).
Submit the complete form to the KEMU financial aid office before the deadline. Incomplete forms are rejected.
Send your result card every year to keep the scholarship.

aid.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship (through KEMU)
aid.amount: HEC says it covers tuition fee plus a stipend; other official pages state Rs. 6,000 per month stipend
aid.whoCanApply: Needy MBBS (1st to final year), Allied Health and DPT students of KEMU. Students already getting a need-based scholarship cannot apply. Self-finance students are not eligible (HEC rule).
howToApply: Download the form from kemu.edu.pk/scholarships (the 2026 round closed on 15 July 2026, later extended).
Fill the form and attach income proof and other documents.
Send or submit it to: Financial Aid Office, Treasurer Department, KEMU, Neela Gumbad, Lahore (contact 0321-8852755).
The university scholarship committee checks need and may interview you.

aid.name: KEMU Merit Scholarship for Position Holders
aid.whoCanApply: Top four MBBS students in the annual exams.
howToApply: Given after annual results are announced (contact Cash Branch, KEMU).

aid.name: KEMU Scholarship Program (donor funded)
aid.amount: Varies by type and funds; paid toward tuition or as a stipend
aid.whoCanApply: Enrolled KEMU students; need-based, merit-based and subject-specific types. A committee looks at grades, leadership and need.
howToApply: Check the scholarship page for open calls and deadlines.
Fill the application and attach documents (transcripts, family income proof, utility bills, personal statement, recommendation letters).
Submit online or email scholarships@kemu.edu.pk before the deadline.

aid.name: Other outside scholarships KEMU lists (PEEF, Ehsaas/HEC, BISE board scholarships, FATA and Gilgit-Baltistan merit scholarships, alumni need-based funds)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program (for example PEEF is for Punjab students; board scholarships for students of that board).
howToApply: KEMU's list says to contact the PEEF office, your board, or HEC, or to apply 'when announced' on the KEMU scholarships page.

universities.name: Allama Iqbal Medical College
universities.about: AIMC is a public medical college in Lahore, started in 1975, linked with Jinnah Hospital. PM&DC lists it with 250 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (at least 55% for MBBS) and have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Punjab domicile (for open merit).
Apply online to UHS Lahore at publicmbbs.uhs.edu.pk (UHS fee Rs. 2,000) and list all public colleges in order of preference.
If UHS places you at AIMC, pay the fee within 3 working days.
Follow the AIMC call letter: fill the AIMC portal, and bring affidavits on e-stamp paper and the Punjab Government surety bond.
Report to the college on the joining date.

hostel.notes: AIMC has hostels for boys and girls. Students apply with a hostel allotment form. A 2025 notice said the hostel fee is Rs. 63,740 per year (non-refundable) for boys and girls, plus a refundable mess security of Rs. 10,000 for boys. Food costs are extra.

costs.academicYear: 2026-27 (tuition set by Punjab Government); hostel fee from AIMC notice for deposit on 1 March 2025
costs.otherNotes: Tuition is from the Punjab 2026-27 admission policy for public colleges (open merit). AIMC's own list of other college charges was not found. Living at home: tuition and college charges only. Living in the hostel: add Rs. 63,740 a year, plus Rs. 10,000 refundable mess security (boys) and monthly food costs. The AIMC 2025-26 call letter includes a Rs. 3 million surety bond to serve the Punjab Health Department for one year after house job.

universities.name: Fatima Jinnah Medical University
universities.about: FJMU is a public medical university for women in Lahore. PM&DC lists its college as 'Fatima Jinnah Medical College for Women' with 300 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (at least 55% for MBBS) and have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Punjab domicile (for open merit).
Apply online to UHS Lahore at publicmbbs.uhs.edu.pk (FJMU says UHS is the admitting university) and pay the Rs. 2,000 fee.
List all public colleges in order of preference (FJMU's medical college is for women).
If placed at FJMU, pay the fee within 3 working days and report to the university.
At admission time, fill the FJMU financial aid application if your family cannot afford the costs.

hostel.notes: FJMU's scholarship page mentions hostel fee and mess fee, so a hostel exists, but hostel rules and charges were not published.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition is from the Punjab 2026-27 admission policy for public colleges (open merit). FJMU's own fee and hostel charges were not found. Living at home: tuition and college charges. Living in the hostel: add hostel and mess fees (amounts not published).

aid.name: FJMU Scholarship / Financial Aid Program
aid.amount: Can be fully funded: college fee, hostel fee and mess fee, based on each student's need
aid.whoCanApply: Good students who face money problems. Funded by national and international donors, including PEF (Professional Education Foundation). Reviewed every year based on family money situation and grades.
howToApply: Fill the financial aid application at the time of admission.
If shortlisted, attend an interview.
Your aid is checked again each year against your results and family situation.
Contact: FJMU, 17 Queen's Road, Lahore, phone +92 (42) 99203718.

universities.name: Rawalpindi Medical University
universities.about: RMU is a public medical university in Rawalpindi. PM&DC lists Rawalpindi Medical College with 350 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (at least 55% for MBBS) and have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Punjab domicile (for open merit).
Apply online to UHS Lahore at publicmbbs.uhs.edu.pk and pay the Rs. 2,000 fee.
List all public colleges in order of preference.
If placed at RMU, pay the fee within 3 working days and report to RMU.
If you need a hostel, contact the hostel clerk / warden's office soon after admission (rooms are limited).

hostel.notes: RMU has two boys' hostels (one on campus, one in Satellite Town about 6 km away) and one girls' hostel (about 2 km away). Rooms are for students from other cities, depend on availability and merit, and you pay the fee within 7 days of approval. RMU's 2025-26 prospectus lists hostel charges (FY 2025) of Rs. 56,626 per year (utilities Rs. 31,944, common room Rs. 550, govt charges Rs. 1,200, misc. hostel fund Rs. 3,960) and a Rs. 5,000 mess security. Food is paid monthly based on the mess menu.

costs.otherNotes: Official numbers do not match each other: the Punjab 2026-27 policy sets public tuition at Rs. 50,000 a year; the RMU prospectus 2025-26 says first-year tuition Rs. 36,500 + Rs. 8,100 misc (later years about Rs. 26,000-26,400 total); RMU's fee web page shows tuition Rs. 15,000 a year with first-year total Rs. 52,100 and Rs. 33,700-33,800 in later years. Living at home: about Rs. 34,000-52,000 a year in college charges (check the 2026-27 voucher). Living in the hostel: add about Rs. 56,626 a year plus food.

aid.name: Fee remission (tuition concession)
aid.amount: Full or half tuition waiver, for up to 10% of Punjab students
aid.whoCanApply: Students from Punjab who are not repeating a year. Decided by the head of the institution based on money situation, conduct and progress.
howToApply: Write an application with a statement of your parent/guardian's financial position.
Submit it with a note from the head of department.
Apply again every year.

aid.name: Donor scholarships through RMU's scholarship committee (FAMS, APPNA, HESP and others)
aid.amount: Varies; in one year RMU listed 361 students getting about Rs. 22.7 million in total
aid.whoCanApply: RMU students chosen by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee after document checks and interviews.
howToApply: Watch RMU scholarship notices.
Apply to the scholarship committee and attend the interview.

aid.name: HEC Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship
aid.amount: RMU lists it as 'University Fee + 40,000 stipend'
aid.whoCanApply: Needy undergraduate students (HEC rules).
howToApply: Apply when HEC opens the round; RMU's scholarship committee handles it.

aid.name: Punjab Government Merit Scholarships
aid.amount: Rs. 1,000 per month (day scholar) or Rs. 2,000 per month (hostel boarder), per RMU prospectus
aid.whoCanApply: Two students each in 2nd, 3rd, 4th and final year MBBS, based on exam results.
howToApply: Awarded by the Principal based on professional exam results.

aid.name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal, District Zakat Committee (MORA), PEF Zakat/Qarz-e-Hasna, NBP interest-free student loan, CM Punjab Honhaar Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program. RMU says one student can get only one scholarship.
howToApply: Contact the in-charge Scholarship Committee or the Students Section at RMU.

universities.name: Nishtar Medical University
universities.about: Nishtar Medical University is a large public medical university in Multan, South Punjab. PM&DC lists Nishtar Medical College with 350 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (at least 55% for MBBS) and have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Punjab domicile (for open merit).
Apply online to UHS Lahore at publicmbbs.uhs.edu.pk (UHS is the admitting university for 2026-27) and pay the Rs. 2,000 fee.
List all public colleges in order of preference.
If placed at Nishtar, pay the fee within 3 working days and report to the university.

hostel.notes: NMU has four boys' hostels (Iqbal, Qasim, Sina, Razi Halls) and three girls' hostels (Old Rafida, New Rafida, Tariq Halls). Charges and rules are not published on the hostel page.

costs.otherNotes: Tuition is from the Punjab 2026-27 admission policy for public colleges (open merit). NMU's own fee and hostel charges were not found. Living at home: tuition and college charges. Living in the hostel: add hostel and food costs (not published).

universities.name: Dow University of Health Sciences (Dow Medical College and Dow International Medical College)
universities.about: DUHS is a large public health university in Karachi. Dow Medical College (DMC, 350 MBBS seats) is the low-fee merit college for local students. Dow International Medical College (DIMC, 150 seats) is a separate, much more expensive college for overseas Pakistanis and foreign nationals, paid in US dollars.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (Sindh MDCAT by Sukkur IBA; at least 55% for MBBS). MDCAT 2024, 2025 or 2026 counts for 2026-27.

Have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical (check the year's advertisement) and a Sindh PRC/domicile. DMC open merit seats are for Karachi district; 22 seats are for other Sindh districts on merit-cum-choice.
Fill the online form on the website of the processing university for your district, print it, and send it with documents by the named courier before the last date (2026-27: 26 October 2026).
Check the provisional and final merit lists and give your choice of college.
If you do not get an open merit seat, you may apply for a self-finance (UEDP local) seat at DMC when it is advertised; these cost about PKR 650,000 per year.
DIMC seats are for overseas Pakistanis and foreign nationals; if they stay empty, they are offered to local students as 'Dow Overseas Sponsored' seats at USD 11,000 per year.

hostel.notes: DUHS has hostels at DMC campus and Ojha campus (about 1,200 places; 3 for girls, 2 for boys). Rooms are shared. Only full-time students from outside Karachi with no other place to live can apply, and only at the time of induction. You apply online (webapps.duhs.edu.pk/hostel) and must pay one year of hostel fee in advance. Ojha residents also pay their own electricity. The yearly hostel fee amount is not published.

costs.otherNotes: Dow Medical College, open merit (2026-27): tuition PKR 48,000 per year; first-year total without transport PKR 124,500 (admission 25,000, tuition 48,000, development 25,000, student activity 10,000, library 10,000, document verification 6,500). Optional transport PKR 50,000 a year. DMC self-finance (UEDP local): tuition PKR 650,000 a year; first-year total about PKR 774,045 with tax. Dow International Medical College (2026-27, per year): Dow Overseas Sponsored USD 11,000 tuition (USD 11,778 with exam fee and tax), Overseas Pakistani USD 18,000, Foreign National USD 20,000, plus admission USD 360 or PKR 100,000. DUHS says all fees go up 10% every year. Living at home: about PKR 124,500 in year one for open merit (less in later years, since admission/one-time charges are not repeated). Living in the hostel: add the hostel fee (not published) and food.

aid.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship (through DUHS)
aid.amount: Actual tuition fee plus Rs. 6,000 per month for the full 5-year MBBS
aid.whoCanApply: Needy students admitted (or competing for admission) in undergraduate programs. Self-finance students are not eligible.
howToApply: Get the form and submit it to the Students Financial Aid Office (SFAO).
The university committee (ISAC) checks your papers and interviews you (and maybe your parents); they may visit your home.
If approved by HEC, open a bank account and sign an undertaking that you have no other scholarship.
Keep passing your exams to continue.

aid.name: DUHS Student Study Loan (interest-free)
aid.amount: Decided by the DUHS Student Study Loan Committee
aid.whoCanApply: Continuing undergraduate students who have money problems that affect their studies.
howToApply: Get the loan form from the Financial Aid Office.
Submit it through your college.
A committee shortlists and decides the amount.

aid.name: Donor and government scholarships handled by DUHS (Sindh Zakat & Ushr / Auqaf, Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal, Sindh Education Endowment Fund, PEF, PEEF, Ehsaas/Benazir HEC, minority scholarships, Scotland Pakistan Scholarship for women, NEST, Ihsan Trust and others)
aid.whoCanApply: Depends on each program.
howToApply: Contact the Financial Aid Office: Ground Floor, Administration Block, DMC Campus, Baba-e-Urdu Road, Karachi.
Phone 021-3877-1000 ext. 5117/5118; email fao@duhs.edu.pk.

universities.name: Jinnah Sindh Medical University
universities.about: JSMU is a public medical university in Karachi. Its MBBS college is Sindh Medical College (350 seats on the PM&DC list).
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (Sindh MDCAT by Sukkur IBA; at least 55% for MBBS; 2024-2026 MDCAT counts for 2026-27).
Have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Sindh PRC/domicile. 232 open merit seats are for Karachi domicile; 46 seats are for interior Sindh (by board) on merit-cum-choice.
Fill the online form on the processing university website for your district, print it, and send it with documents by the named courier before the last date (2026-27: 26 October 2026).
Check the merit lists and choose your college.
If you miss open merit, you can apply for one of the 34 self-finance (UEDP local) seats when advertised (PKR 650,000 a year).
After admission, apply to the Financial Aid Department for scholarships from 2nd year (most JSMU scholarships do not accept new 1st-year students).

hostel.notes: JSMU has MBBS boys' and girls' hostels. Students collect fee vouchers from the hostel and pay the yearly hostel fee at a bank (2026 notices). The hostel fee amount is not published in these notices.

costs.otherNotes: Open merit (2026-27): admission fee 20,000 (once), tuition 48,000 per year (goes up 10% a year), exam fee 7,500 per year, plus one-time charges; first-year total PKR 103,500. Optional transport PKR 40,000 a year. Self-finance (UEDP local): tuition PKR 650,000 a year. Overseas self-finance: USD 12,000 a year (2025-26 prospectus). Living at home: about PKR 103,500 in year one, then about 55,500+ a year. Living in the hostel: add the hostel fee (amount not published) and food.

aid.name: JSMU/HEC Undergraduate Scholarship
aid.amount: HEC need-based scholarship covers tuition fee and a stipend (HEC)
aid.whoCanApply: JSMU undergraduates from 2nd year onward. Not for newly admitted, self-finance, or repeating-year students, or students already getting a scholarship.
howToApply: Print the application form (2026 window: 1-30 April 2026).
Attach: last transcript, college/enrollment card, your CNIC and father's CNIC, father's death certificate (if needed), salary slip or income certificate, utility bills, and all fee vouchers.
Submit to the Financial Aid Department, JSMU.
Attend the interview on your given date (no rescheduling).

aid.name: Need-cum-Merit Scholarship from Zakat & Ushr Department, Government of Sindh
aid.whoCanApply: Students from 2nd year onward who are eligible for Zakat. Not for Syed, minority, or self-finance students.
howToApply: Download the scholarship form from the JSMU website (2026 window: 15-31 January).

Attach: Istahaq certificate from the Chairman, District Zakat & Ushr Committee; salary slip or income proof; FBR tax filing report; CNIC and enrollment card; last mark sheet; 6 months of electricity bills.
Submit to the Financial Aid Department, 4th Floor, New Dental Building.

aid.name: Sindh Educational Endowment Fund (SEEF) Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Poor, needy and meritorious students not getting any other scholarship (2025-26 fresh round closed 31 August 2026).
howToApply: Apply with the required documents to the JSMU Financial Aid Department before the deadline in the notice.

aid.name: JSMU merit and need-based scholarships, PEF, NBP and Ihsan Trust interest-free loans, minority scholarships, Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal
aid.whoCanApply: JSMU students; JSMU says its aim is that no student should stop studying because they cannot pay fees.
howToApply: Check notices on the JSMU scholarships page and apply to the Scholarship Section / Financial Aid Department (phone 021-99205185).

universities.name: Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences
universities.about: LUMHS in Jamshoro (near Hyderabad) is the oldest medical institution in Sindh, started in 1881. PM&DC lists it with 350 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (Sindh MDCAT by Sukkur IBA; at least 55% for MBBS).
Have at least 60% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Sindh PRC/domicile from a district tagged to LUMHS (for example Hyderabad, Jamshoro, Thatta, Badin, Mirpurkhas, Tharparkar, Sanghar and others).
Fill the online form at admportal.lumhs.edu.pk, print it, and send it with documents by Leopards Courier (Rs. 3,500 per program) before 26 October 2026.
Check the district-wise merit lists; seats are given on merit-cum-choice.
If you miss a merit seat, you can apply for a UDP self-finance seat (PKR 650,000 a year) when invited after the merit list.

hostel.notes: LUMHS has hostels for boys and girls. You pay the hostel fee at admission. Other hostels (boys and girls): allotment fee Rs. 5,000 once, hostel fee Rs. 50,000 per year, ID card Rs. 100 per year (first year Rs. 55,100; later years Rs. 50,100). Al-Tibri International Hostel (boys) costs Rs. 5,000 per month, plus Rs. 10,000 per month for AC.

costs.otherNotes: District merit, reciprocal, disabled and PTAP seats: admission fee PKR 20,000 (once) + tuition PKR 48,000 per year (first year PKR 68,000). Other charges: PM&DC registration 7,000 (once), document verification 5,000 (once), student activities 10,000 (once), university development 10,000 per year, transport 15,000 per year (optional). UDP self-finance: PKR 650,000 a year. Overseas/foreign self-finance: USD 11,000 a year. Living at home: about PKR 100,000 in year one, then about PKR 58,000 a year. Living in the hostel: add PKR 55,100 in year one and PKR 50,100 each later year, plus food. Not for Bilawal Medical College (separate fee).

aid.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship (through LUMHS)
aid.amount: HEC: tuition fee plus stipend
aid.whoCanApply: Needy MBBS/BDS students on merit seats (self-finance students are not eligible). LUMHS interviewed 1st-year MBBS and BDS applicants for the 2025-26 round in May 2026.
howToApply: Watch LUMHS circulars for the call.
Submit the form and documents to the Students' Financial Aid Office (SFAO) / Directorate of Student Affairs, Academic Block.
Attend the interview with the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee.

aid.name: Zakat Need-cum-Merit Scholarship
aid.whoCanApply: Students from low-income families, orphans and differently-abled students.
howToApply: Apply through the LUMHS Students Financial Aid Office when the call is announced.

aid.name: SOS Children's Village Freeship
aid.amount: Full freeship (tuition and related academic costs)
aid.whoCanApply: Students from SOS Children's Village.
howToApply: Contact the LUMHS Students Financial Aid Office.

aid.name: LUMHS Alumni Centre scholarship fund, PEF scholarship, minority scholarships
aid.whoCanApply: Needy and meritorious students; PEF gives special encouragement to orphans and differently-abled students; minority scholarships with the Ministry of Religious Affairs.
howToApply: Contact the Students Financial Aid Office (SFAO) at LUMHS.

universities.name: Khyber Medical College (admissions through Khyber Medical University)
universities.about: Khyber Medical College in Peshawar was founded in 1954 and is linked with Khyber Teaching Hospital. PM&DC lists it with 250 MBBS seats. All KP public MBBS admissions are handled by Khyber Medical University (KMU).
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (KP MDCAT by KMU; at least 55% for MBBS; 2024, 2025 or 2026 MDCAT counts for 2026-27).
Have at least 65% in FSc Pre-Medical and a KP or Newly Merged Districts domicile.
Apply online at cas.kmu.edu.pk before 21 October 2026, 5:00 PM, and pay the Rs. 3,000 processing fee. Choose your colleges in order of preference.
KMU makes the merit list (SSC 10% + HSSC 40% + MDCAT 50%) and places you by merit and choice.
When you get a placement order for KMC, report with originals: Matric and FSc certificates, domicile, notarized undertaking on Rs. 100 stamp paper, photos, CNIC copies, and other papers.
If you need a hostel, register with the Chief Provost Office quickly (first come, first served).

hostel.notes: KMC has four hostels: Qasim Hall (1st-2nd year), Razi Hall (3rd-4th year), Cenna Hall (final year) and a Girls Hostel (all years). They are for students who are not residents of Peshawar. Register through the Chief Provost Office; places are limited. Hostel charges are not published.

costs.otherNotes: Open merit at KMC (also Khyber Girls Medical College and Ayub Medical College), 2024-25: first-year total PKR 102,000 (admission 3,500, litigation 5,000, exam/skills 13,000, KMU affiliation 15,000, tuition 51,500, student fund 14,000); 2nd year 102,000; 3rd year 112,000; 4th year 123,200; final year 135,520. Other KP public colleges are cheaper. Self-finance seats cost more (amount not confirmed here). Living at home: about PKR 102,000 a year at the start. Living in the hostel: add hostel and food costs (not published).

aid.name: KMC need-based financial assistance / fee concession
aid.whoCanApply: KMC MBBS students in financial need (KMC has held financial assistance interviews for need-based aid).
howToApply: Fill the KMC fee concession form (linked on the KMC website).
Attend the financial assistance interview when announced.

universities.name: Bolan Medical College (Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences)
universities.about: Bolan Medical College in Quetta is Balochistan's main public medical college, under Bolan University of Medical & Health Sciences (BUMHS). PM&DC lists it with 300 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: Pass MDCAT (Balochistan MDCAT by BUMHS; at least 55% for MBBS).
Have at least 65% in FSc Pre-Medical and a Balochistan local/domicile certificate.
Register on bmc.edu.pk with your email, fill the online form (marks, domicile, college preferences), upload your photo and click 'Save & Submit'.
Print the 'Final Copy' and bank challan, pay the application fee at National Bank of Pakistan, and submit the print to the BMC Admission Branch.
Check the provisional and final merit lists on the BMC website (provincial, divisional and district seats).
If selected, bring original documents for verification, pay the fee, and sign the Rs. 3 million surety bond to serve Balochistan for one year after house job.

hostel.notes: BMC has student hostels (five blocks), but the prospectus says the college does not promise rooms to new students. Rooms, if available, are given on merit after you pay the hostel fee of Rs. 5,000 per year (non-refundable). Mess (food) dues are separate.

costs.otherNotes: Balochistan government colleges, 2025-26: first year PKR 37,000 total (admission 5,000, academic fee 5,000, welfare fund 20,000, PM&DC registration 7,000). 2nd year to final year: PKR 5,000 a year (academic 2,500 + welfare 2,500). 'tuitionPerYear' here is the first-year 'academic fee'. Living at home: PKR 37,000 in year one, then PKR 5,000 a year. Living in the hostel (if a room is given): add PKR 5,000 a year plus food.

universities.name: Army Medical College (National University of Medical Sciences)
universities.about: Army Medical College in Rawalpindi is a military medical college under the National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS). PM&DC lists it with 200 MBBS seats.
admissionSteps: For 2026-27, NUMS lists Army Medical College as 'For Medical Cadets Only', so you enter through the Pakistan Army medical cadet selection, not through UHS.
Take the NUMS MDCAT (pass mark 55% for MBBS).
Merit at NUMS is: entrance test 50% + FSc/HSSC 40% + Matric/SSC 10%.
Apply online on the NUMS website when admissions open (NUMS 2026-27 central admission notice).
